title: Psycholoog Nazorg & Begeleiding (m/v/x)
description:
Als psycholoog bij Nazorgdienst HKM ondersteun je adoptiegezinnen vanuit nabijheid, in elke fase van hun verhaal. Je bent een veilige, warme aanwezigheid voor kinderen, jongeren en adoptieouders: iemand die meeloopt, meevoelt en meezoekt naar rust, houvast en groei.

Je maakt deel uit van een hecht team dat gezinnen ondersteunt met aandacht, tijd, nabijheid en echte betrokkenheid.

Onze dienst biedt zorg en begeleiding aan alle Vlaamse adoptiegezinnen met kinderen en jongeren tot 18 jaar. We ondersteunen gezinnen vanaf de aankomst van hun adoptiekind tot ver voorbij de scharnierleeftijden. Onze werking is intensief, warm, outreachend en kwaliteitsvol, met een sterke focus op hechting, trauma, ontwikkeling, identiteit en emotionele groei.

We zoeken een psycholoog die met professionaliteit, warmte en adoptiesensitiviteit wil meebouwen aan deze sterke en groeiende nazorgwerking.

Jouw taken

Begeleiding & opvolging
Je wordt actief betrokken in de volledige nazorgwerking die HKM de voorbije jaren uitbouwde:
• Huisbezoeken na aankomst: maandelijks tijdens de eerste 6 maanden, daarna om de 3 maanden tot 2 jaar en vervolgens een traject op maat, afgestemd op de noden van het gezin. Voor de huisbezoeken leg je regelmatig langere afstanden af binnen Vlaanderen.
• Laagdrempelige opvolging op scharnierleeftijden (7, 12 en 15 jaar).
• Gesprekken met kinderen, jongeren en ouders rond hechting, trauma, ontwikkeling, identiteit en gezinssystemen.
• Psychologische ondersteuning bij vragen rond afkomst, identiteit en verwantschap, met aandacht voor draagkracht, timing, emotionele impact en wat zulke vragen kunnen losmaken.
• Outreachende opvolging bij signalen van stress, schoolzorgen, gedragsveranderingen of emotionele noden.
• Crisisinterventie wanneer gezinnen tijdelijk extra ondersteuning nodig hebben.
• Schooloverleg en afstemming met CLB’s en leerkrachten.
• Meezoeken naar passende bijkomende hulpverlening wanneer gezinnen nood hebben aan extra ondersteuning.

Samenwerking & overleg
• Nauw samenwerken binnen een klein, multidisciplinair team van psychologen en zorgbegeleiders.
• Afstemming met partners in de keten om gezinnen zo goed mogelijk te ondersteunen.
• Deelname aan casusbesprekingen, intervisie en teamoverleg.
• Mee vormgeven van infosessies, vormingen en ontmoetingsmomenten.
• Ondersteuning door de directeur, die instaat voor beleid, kwaliteitsbewaking, teamcoördinatie en een goed georganiseerde werking.

Administratie & rapportering

title: Psycholoog Nazorg & Begeleiding (m/v/x) - Regio Oost- en West‑Vlaanderen
description:
Als psycholoog bij Nazorgdienst HKM ondersteun je adoptiegezinnen vanuit nabijheid, in elke fase van hun verhaal. Je bent een veilige, warme aanwezigheid voor kinderen, jongeren en adoptieouders: iemand die meeloopt, meevoelt en meezoekt naar rust, houvast en groei.

Je maakt deel uit van een hecht team dat gezinnen ondersteunt met aandacht, tijd, nabijheid en echte betrokkenheid.

Onze dienst biedt zorg en begeleiding aan alle Vlaamse adoptiegezinnen met kinderen en jongeren tot 18 jaar. We ondersteunen gezinnen vanaf de aankomst van hun adoptiekind tot ver voorbij de scharnierleeftijden. Onze werking is intensief, warm, outreachend en kwaliteitsvol, met een sterke focus op hechting, trauma, ontwikkeling, identiteit en emotionele groei.

We zoeken een psycholoog die met professionaliteit, warmte en adoptiesensitiviteit wil meebouwen aan deze sterke en groeiende nazorgwerking.

Jouw taken

Begeleiding & opvolging
Je wordt actief betrokken in de volledige nazorgwerking die HKM de voorbije jaren uitbouwde:
• Huisbezoeken na aankomst: maandelijks tijdens de eerste 6 maanden, daarna om de 3 maanden tot 2 jaar en vervolgens een traject op maat, afgestemd op de noden van het gezin. Voor de huisbezoeken leg je regelmatig langere afstanden af binnen Vlaanderen.
• Laagdrempelige opvolging op scharnierleeftijden (7, 12 en 15 jaar).
• Gesprekken met kinderen, jongeren en ouders rond hechting, trauma, ontwikkeling, identiteit en gezinssystemen.
• Psychologische ondersteuning bij vragen rond afkomst, identiteit en verwantschap, met aandacht voor draagkracht, timing, emotionele impact en wat zulke vragen kunnen losmaken.
• Outreachende opvolging bij signalen van stress, schoolzorgen, gedragsveranderingen of emotionele noden.
• Crisisinterventie wanneer gezinnen tijdelijk extra ondersteuning nodig hebben.
• Schooloverleg en afstemming met CLB’s en leerkrachten.
• Meezoeken naar passende bijkomende hulpverlening wanneer gezinnen nood hebben aan extra ondersteuning.

Samenwerking & overleg
• Nauw samenwerken binnen een klein, multidisciplinair team van psychologen en zorgbegeleiders.
• Afstemming met partners in de keten om gezinnen zo goed mogelijk te ondersteunen.
• Deelname aan casusbesprekingen, intervisie en teamoverleg.
• Mee vormgeven van infosessies, vormingen en ontmoetingsmomenten.
• Ondersteuning door de directeur, die instaat voor beleid, kwaliteitsbewaking, teamcoördinatie en een goed georganiseerde werking.

Administratie & rapportering
• Uitgebreide, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige verslaggeving van gesprekken en huisbezoeken.
• Voorbereiding van opvolgingsrapporten voor herkomstlanden.
• Respectvolle en nauwgezette omgang met vertrouwelijke dossiers, met oog voor zowel kwaliteit als menselijkheid.

Jouw profiel
Diploma & kennis
• Master Klinische Psychologie.
• Sterke kennis van hechting, trauma, ontwikkelingspsychologie, adoptiedriehoek en gezinssystemen.
• Goede kennis van Nederlands; Frans/Engels is een plus.
• Basiskennis Microsoft Office.

Vaardigheden
• Warm, empathisch en professioneel in contact met gezinnen.
• Sterk in actief luisteren, inschatten van noden en helder communiceren.
• Stressbestendig, integer en cultureel sensitief.
• Zelfstandig kunnen werken, maar ook vlot samenwerken in team.
• Nauwkeurig in administratie en verslaggeving.
• Neutrale, professionele houding tegenover interlandelijke adoptie.
• Bereidheid om verplaatsingen te maken in heel Vlaanderen voor huisbezoeken en outreachende opvolging.

Arbeidsduur
• Voltijds of 4/5 is bespreekbaar.

Regio & aanwezigheid

De regio van deze functie is Oost- en West‑Vlaanderen. Om de kwaliteit van onze begeleiding te waarborgen en de samenwerking binnen het team te versterken, vragen we dat je wekelijks 1 tot maximaal 2 dagen aanwezig bent op het kantoor in Geel. Deze momenten zijn belangrijk voor teamoverleg, casusbesprekingen en inhoudelijke afstemming.

title: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

  • Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
  • Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
  • Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
  • Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
  • Supervise external contractors and service providers

You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

  • Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
  • Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
  • Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
  • Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
  • Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

title: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

  • Transport of frozen goods
  • National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
  • Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
  • Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

  • Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
  • Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
  • Has a good level of English
  • Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
  • Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby truck cannot be taken home)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

  • You must already be living in Belgium
  • You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

title: Maintenance Technician (Junior) – Full Training Provided
description:
Founded in 1948, our client is a Belgian family-owned company specializing in exterior joinery. The group operates several production sites manufacturing aluminium, PVC and wooden windows, doors, garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems. The company is known for its modern production facilities, continuous innovation and long-term investment in employee development.


Jobomschrijving

If you are passionate about technology, eager to learn, and looking to build your career in a modern manufacturing environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Our client is looking for Junior Maintenance Technicians / Electromechanics who have a technical education and are motivated to develop their skills through comprehensive on-the-job training.

Without reliable maintenance, there is no quality! As a Maintenance Technician, you will help ensure the smooth operation of production by performing preventive maintenance, identifying technical issues, and supporting continuous improvements.

During approximately the first year, you will work in a two-shift system (early and late shifts) while completing your training. After your training period, you must be willing to work night shifts as part of the regular production schedule.

We are primarily looking for candidates who:

  • Have a technical education in Electromechanics, or a related technical field (Bachelor's degree, Associate degree, technical secondary education, or equivalent).
  • Have a basic understanding of mechatronics, including fundamentals of PLC systems, sensors, actuators, electricity, mechanics and pneumatics.
  • Are motivated to learn and develop through practical training in the workplace.
  • Have a hands-on mentality and enjoy solving technical problems.
  • Work accurately and pay attention to safety.
  • Enjoy working in a team and communicate well with colleagues.
  • Have a communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

title: Logistics Specialist
description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

  • Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
  • Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
  • Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
  • Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
  • Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
  • Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.

Receiving Operations:

  • Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
  • Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
  • Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
  • Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
  • Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
  • Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Continuously assess opportunities for process improvement.
  • Contribute ideas to optimize inbound goods flows, including transportation, booking slots, and packaging.
  • Prepare reports on KPIs, carrier performance, packaging usage, and related metrics.
  • Coordinate with carriers and suppliers when KPI targets are not achieved.

Driver Reception Desk:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.
  • Process, create, and manage CMRs, packing lists, invoices, and export documentation for both incoming and outgoing AM/OE shipments.
  • Provide drivers with all required documentation.
  • Perform administrative tasks.
  • Print locator labels and tickets.
  • Resolve operational issues and exceptions.

Outbound (Backup Support):

  • Create deliveries based on Excel files, emails, or SAP follow-up activities.
  • Determine picking priorities based on collection schedules while considering warehouse picking capacity.
  • Release and coordinate transportation for ICY shipments within and outside Europe.
  • Release and monitor transportation activities for the French market.
  • Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
  • Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
  • Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
  • Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.
  • Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
  • Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
  • Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Customer-oriented mindset.
  • Continuous improvement mentality.
  • Team player.
  • Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
  • Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

title: Executive Assistant - European Association
description:
We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to the Director General. This is a key position requiring exceptional organisational skills, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast-paced international environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established European association based in Brussels, representing and supporting members across Europe. Operating in an international and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in fostering collaboration, advocacy, and knowledge sharing within its sector.

Description

  • Act as the trusted right hand and strategic support to the Director General
  • Manage a complex agenda, shifting priorities, and high-level executive commitments
  • Coordinate international travel, itineraries, and meeting preparations
  • Monitor and manage the Director General's inbox, correspondence, and follow-ups
  • Prepare presentations, briefing documents, reports, and executive materials
  • Ensure action points are tracked and deadlines are met across multiple projects
  • Organise and coordinate Board Meetings, General Assemblies, and leadership meetings
  • Take meeting minutes and follow up on agreed actions
  • Build strong relationships with members, partners, and key stakeholders across Europe
  • Liaise with internal teams to ensure smooth communication and coordination
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion
  • Maintain accurate records, databases, and executive documentation
  • Review expenses, approvals, and administrative processes
  • Act as a key point of contact on behalf of the Director General when required
  • Support the smooth functioning of the executive office and provide back-up within the administrative team
  • Anticipate needs, solve problems proactively, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

  • 15 to 20 years of experience in a similar Executive Assistant role
  • Previous experience supporting C-level or Executive-level leadership
  • Experience within an international organisation, association, federation, or EU environment is highly desirable
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Excellent command of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook)
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset
  • Highly professional, trustworthy, and discreet
  • Eager to learn and continuously improve

title: Freelance IT Infrastructure Consultant
description:
Our client is an engineering company.


Jobomschrijving

1. IT Infrastructure Governance & Strategy

  • Assess business and end-user needs, as well as quality, operational, and security requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into IT solutions and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Design, maintain, and continuously improve the local IT infrastructure architecture in alignment with business objectives and Group standards.
  • Advise management on IT strategy, technology evolution, infrastructure investments, and risk mitigation.
  • Monitor emerging technologies and recommend improvements to systems, services, and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, licensing, and corporate requirements.



2. User Support & Service Delivery

  • Provide technical support to end-users through telephone, e-mail, remote assistance, and face-to-face interventions.
  • Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and system-related issues.
  • Assist end-users in the effective use of IT equipment, systems, and applications.

  • Coordinate with external providers and Group IT teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.

title: Mold Technician
description:
Company Activities

title: Captain for Tugboat

title: Production Operator (with housing)
description:
Company Activities

Our client is more than just a packaging glass producer. They are a family business with an international outlook, driven by technology, sustainability, and people.

In our client’s IS Department (Glass Forming Department, Hot End), molten glass arrives from the glass furnace, where it is cut into gobs and transported via the feeder to the production line. The glass gob then drops into a mould, where it is blown into shape and coated with a hot-end coating. Within this department, you will play a key role in operating, monitoring, and adjusting the process while ensuring quality and efficiency.


Jobomschrijving

As an Operator within the production department of our client, you will find yourself at the beating heart of their glass organization.

We do provide housing.

We do not provide work permits.

Key responsibilities:

  • Ensure the smooth operation of the production process by controlling and monitoring gob control systems, the lehr, and conveyor systems, adjusting process parameters, and checking temperature values.
  • Prepare the required equipment prior to production changeovers and replace refractory components when needed.
  • Clean and maintain machinery, installations, and the working environment.
  • Identify, report, and accurately document technical malfunctions and process deviations.
  • Monitor product quality by carrying out inspections and measurements (including weight, heat, and temperature checks) and maintaining records such as process data, mould numbers, and production settings.
  • Provide a thorough shift handover to the incoming team at the end of your shift.

The following criteria are important:

  • Experience in a production environment.
  • Willingness to attend training sessions during the day at various training locations.
  • Ability to work with a computer.
  • Good command of English or Dutch.
  • Actively contribute to a pleasant team atmosphere and be helpful to colleagues.
  • Flexible with the task package, especially during the startup phase.
  • No issues with working in a warm environment (temperatures up to 40 degrees).
  • Physical work does not deter you.
  • Basic technical knowledge.

title: Bus Mechanic

title: Electrical Maintenance Technician

Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal

title: Executive Assistant - Law Firm - Brussels

title: Assistant Location Manager @Kortrijk
description:
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Spring jij graag bij waar nodig is? Hou je van een job waar geen dag hetzelfde is en waar energie en actie centraal staan? Perfect!

Voor onze klant, dé marktleider in trampolineparken in België, Nederland, Duitsland en Frankrijk, zijn we op zoek naar een enthousiaste Assistant Park Manager in jouw regio.

In deze rol ben jij de spil van het park: je springt (letterlijk en figuurlijk!) van de keuken naar het onthaal, van het team naar de gasten, en van operationele taken naar creatieve uitdagingen.

Jouw missie? Ervoor zorgen dat élke bezoeker met een glimlach en vermoeide benen naar huis gaat!

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Als Assistant Park Manager ben je veel meer dan een manager achter een bureau.

Je bent overal: in de keuken, in de zaal, aan de kassa én op de werkvloer.

Je stuurt aan, denkt mee, pakt door én inspireert je team om elke dag het beste van zichzelf te geven.

Concreet betekent dat:

  • Je draait volop mee in de dagelijkse operatie: keuken, zaal, onthaal — you name it, you do it
  • Je zorgt samen met jouw team voor een 'service beyond expectations' — want tevreden gasten komen terug!
  • Je houdt het overzicht: administratie, kassabeheer, bestellingen… jij weet precies wat er speelt
  • Je beheert de voorraad met wekelijkse inventarisaties en zorgt dat er altijd voldoende stock is
  • Je regelt de personeelsadministratie en houdt alles netjes bij
  • Je coacht en motiveert je team, en begeleidt nieuwe collega's tijdens hun eerste stappen
  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit
  • Je bedenkt gave acties en events om het park nóg populairder te maken in de buurt

Herken jij jezelf hierin?

  • Je hebt leidinggevende ervaring in leisure, horeca of retail — een diploma is leuk, maar ervaring weegt voor ons zwaarder
  • Je bent een geboren teamleider: communicatief sterk, besluitvaardig en je durft een groep jonge, energieke medewerkers aan te sturen
  • Ook als het druk is en de zaal vol zit, blijf jij glimlachen en straal je pure klantvriendelijkheid uit
  • Hands-on is jouw second nature — je steekt zonder aarzelen zelf de handen uit de mouwen
  • Structuur en organisatie zitten in je DNA, en zelfstandig werken is geen enkel probleem
  • Je denkt commercieel en ziet omzet als een leuke uitdaging in plaats van een verplichting
  • Flexibiliteit? Check! Vroege diensten, late shifts, weekenden — maakt je allemaal niets uit

description:
An international technology company operating in the media sector is looking for an Information Security Engineer to join the IT Security team within the corporate IT department. This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, operational follow-up, coordination, and continuous improvement. The position is part of a structured cybersecurity and compliance programme in the context of NIS2 obligations under Belgian law and the implementation of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, with a target of April 2027. The consultant/employee will contribute directly to control implementation, evidence production, and audit readiness across the corporate IT perimeter.

Main responsibilities

Security operations & monitoring:
  • Monitor and investigate security alerts across multiple security platforms
  • Participate in incident response activities and support the coordination of security investigations
  • Improve and tune detection capabilities and monitoring use cases
  • Support the development and maintenance of operational security procedures and playbooks
  • Perform operational security reviews and follow-up activities

Vulnerability & exposure management:
  • Coordinate vulnerability scanning activities and ensure findings are reviewed and prioritized
  • Follow up remediation actions with infrastructure, platform, application, and support teams
  • Track remediation progress and escalate overdue actions when required
  • Coordinate external penetration tests and security assessments
  • Ensure findings from assessments and pentests are documented, tracked, and remediated

Security assessments & risk management:
  • Perform security reviews of applications, services, and technical solutions
  • Contribute to risk assessments for new projects, technologies, and providers
  • Review security configurations and identify improvement opportunities
  • Support the identification and management of security risks across the IT environment

Security governance & reporting:
  • Maintain and monitor operational security KPIs and dashboards
  • Support reporting related to vulnerabilities, incidents, security posture, and remediation efforts
  • Participate in periodic reviews of user access, privileged accounts, and security controls
  • Contribute to compliance activities and implementation of security requirements related to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIS2
  • Produce and maintain auditable evidence of security control operations, including logs, reports, review records, and remediation closure evidence

Security improvement & automation:
  • Identify opportunities to improve security controls and operational processes
  • Contribute to...
... Experience:
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, vulnerability management, or a related technical security role
  • Experience in security monitoring, incident handling, or vulnerability management
  • Experience working with security tools and operational security processes

Technical knowledge:
  • Understanding of security monitoring and incident response principles
  • Knowledge of vulnerability management processes and risk-based remediation prioritization, including CVSS scores, asset criticality, exploitability context, and compensating controls
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender XDR suite: Defender for EndPoint, Defender for Office 365 / Exchange Online Protection, and Defender for Identity
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Sentinel or an equivalent SIEM platform; deployment experience is a strong asset
  • Understanding of Entra ID governance, including Conditional Access, Identity Protection, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Purview
  • Understanding of network security fundamentals, including Firewall management with Palo Alto or FortiGate, log forwarding, and network segmentation principles
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and best practices such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different teams
  • Curious, proactive, and willing to continuously learn new technologies and security trends
  • Strong communication and coordination skills
  • Practical and solution-oriented team player

Languages:
  • Fluent French
  • Professional English required

Nice to have certifications

  • SC-300 — Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator
  • CompTIA Security+ or Cysa+
  • ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor

description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

title: Customer Support Associate with Norwegian & English – Sofia, Bulgaria
description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Danish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions

    Accurately document customer interactions and follow established processes
    Provide professional, clear, and empathetic support in every interaction

🧠 What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Norwegian – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

🎁 What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

Som Solutions Consultant bliver du teknisk rådgiver og produktekspert for dansktalende kunder. Du hjælper kunder med at løse produktrelaterede og tekniske problemer og sikrer en professionel kundeoplevelse.

  • Yde support på både dansk og engelsk

  • Mulighed for performancebonus

  • Refusion af flybillet på ca. €75

  • Hjælp til at finde en lejlighed

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Taler dansk

  • Er serviceminded og god til at kommunikere

Lyder det som noget for dig? Send din ansøgning via Jobnet, så kontakter Nordcrest Recruitment relevante kandidater med mere information om stillingen.

title: Svensktalande E-Commerce Advisor i Bulgarien
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Concentrix Bulgaria is now looking for a number of dynamic and self-motivated Customer Advisors to join our exciting new project.

VF is the global company behind some of the world’s leading lifestyle brands including household names such as, Timberland, The North Face, Napapijri, Lee, Wrangler, Vans Eastpak and Kipling
Our aim is to consistently deliver world class customer service and we never lose sight of our goal - our customers are the focus of everything we do here! From email to phone in a multitude of languages, we’re on hand to offer care to all our customers to make sure they have a fun and enjoyable shopping experience with us.  

We’re an energetic, innovative and forward thinking team who are always looking for new ideas to delight and wow our customers.  The Customer Advisor is required to:

•    Be proficient (verbal & written) in Swedish
•    Be advanced in English
•    Be able to represent our client’s brands and deliver outstanding customer service with clarity, passion and enthusiasm
•    Be flexible to meet the changing needs and varying deadlines of our business
•    Be able to work to customer service measures, metrics and KPIs within a service targeted environment.
•    Hold a High-school or University degree
•    Possess excellent computer literacy
•    Have previous experience in a customer service environment, preferably telephone based.

Main responsibilities:

•    Communicating with customers by telephone, email and online to provide outstanding service
•    Building a rapport with customers to help them with enquiries including; order taking, product information, tracking deliveries, returns, sizing and quality queries
•    Discussing new products and managing multiple tasks to promptly resolve customer queries
•    Identifying ways to improve processes in order to improve sales, brand loyalty and the customer service and experience
•    Updating our systems with information and helping marketing, retail and other teams to further improve customer service and satisfaction.
Who are we:
Concentrix, a wholly owned subsidiary of SYNNEX Corporation (NYSE: SNX), is a leading business services company. We focus on customer engagement and improving business outcomes for over 450 global clients across many continents. Our 100,000+ staff deliver technology-infused, omni-channel customer experience management, marketing optimization, digital, consulting, analytics and back office solutions in 40+ languages from 125+ delivery centres. We serve automotive; banking and financial services; insurance; healthcare; technology; consumer electronics; media and communications; retail and e-commerce; travel and transportation; and energy and public-sector clients.

title: Customer Support Associate with Norwegian & English – Sofia, Bulgaria
description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Danish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions
    Resolve customer concerns efficiently and aim for first-contact resolution whenever possible
    Accurately document customer interactions and follow established processes
    Provide professional, clear, and empathetic support in every interaction

🧠 What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Norwegian – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

🎁 What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

Work Environment:

    Onsite from our Sofia office
    Working hours: 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday
    Voice and non-voice customer support

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

  • Dnevno kontrolira čišćenje, podmazivanje, kontrole curenja ulja na svim strojevima.
  • Svakodnevno provjeravanje podešenosti strojeva te izvršenje potrebnih podešavanja.
  • Dnevna kontrola i otklanjanje kvarova na sustavu linija otprašivanja.
  • Popravak i remont linija obrade duhana, linija sjetve i otkupa duhana te popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svog djelokruga.
  • Redovno provjerava radno stanje opreme, radi tehnička podešavanja, obavještava Rukovoditelja održavanja o uočenim problemima.
  • Radi na smanjenju potrošnje energije.
  • Izrada dijelova u skladu sa dostavljenim specifikacijama.
  • Rastavljanje strojeva u slučaju potrebe, popravak i zamjena neispravnih komponenti strojeva.
  • Sudjeluje u instalaciji proizvodne opreme i strojeva.
  • Nadzire rad opreme i strojeva, brine o hidraulučnim platformama i pometačima podova u pogonu.
  • Održava čistoću i urednost radnog okruženja.
  • Sudjeluje u pripremi akcija preventivnog održavanja.
  • Osigurava da su svi alati i materijali koji se koriste prikladni, sigurni i u skladu s relevantnim standardima i zahtjevima tvrtke.
  • Održavanje, popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svogdjelokruga.
  • Po potrebi radi u drugim sektorima, sva područja obrade duhana (pakiranje, sušenje, biranje, ulaz, itd.), na sjetvi plitica, otkupu duhana.
  • Ostali zadaci u skladu s naravi i vrstom rada po nalogu neposredno nadređenog.
Uvjeti
  • Potrebna stručna sprema: SSS-srednja stručna sprema.
  • Zahtijevana struka: tehnička struke (elektro, strojarska).
  • Osnovno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu.
  • Osnovno znanje rada na računalu: Ms Office.
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
Prednosti
  • Sposobnost brze identifikacije i rješavanja problema.
  • Iskustvo u razumijevanju tehničke dokumentacije.
  • Izvrsna sposobnost vođenja evidencije.
  • Komunikacijske vještine.
  • Fleksibilnost i timski rad.
  • Sposobnost postavljanja prioriteta.
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo od dvije godine u struci ili na sličnim poslovima.
Nudimo benefite i pogodnosti:
  • Briga o zdravlju: dopunsko i dodatno zdravstveno osiguranje (sistematski i specijalistički pregledi i slično), osiguranje zaposlenika od nezgode (24/7), besplatno korištenje teretane.
  • Financijske pogodnosti: Božićnica, regres za godišnji odmor, naknada za podmirivanje troškova prehrane, potpora za rođenje djeteta, naknada za troškove prijevoza, itd.
  • Priznanja i nagrade: godišnji bonus, godišnja korekcija plaće, razna nefinacijska nagrađivanja putem nominacija za prepoznavanje truda i postignuća.
  • Balans privatnog i poslovnog: plaćeni i neplaćeni dopust za razne osobne potrebe, slobodan radni dan povodom rođendana zaposlenika, razna online savjetovanja za zaposlenike i programi pomoći te savjetovanja za razne životne teme.
  • Okruženje koje pokreće: podršku od strane kolega i voditelja, kontinuirani razvoj kroz stručno usavršavanje, obilježavanje događaja gdje slavimo uspjeh i izražavamo zahvalnost prema našim zaposlenicima.
Trajanje ugovora: Na određeno vrijeme s mogućnošću zasnivanja radnog odnosa na neodređeno vrijeme. Prijavite se na oglas i pridružite se uspješnoj međunarodnoj grupi. Veselimo se Vašoj prijavi!

title: PROJEKTANT SURADNIK/PROJEKTANTICA SURADNICA
description:
PROJEKTANT SURADNIK (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant suradnik (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant suradnik sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih rad

title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE NA TALIJANSKOM JEZIKU U PRODUŽENOM BORAVKU
description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta učitelja/učiteljice razredne nastave na talijanskom jeziku u produženom boravku na neodređeno i puno radno vrijeme – 2 izvršitelja/izvršiteljice, uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama TRAŽENI UVJETI: 1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), sukladno Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20) i temeljem Odluke o organizaciji i provedbi produženog boravka i cjelodnevnog odgojno-obrazovnog rada u osnovnim školama Grada Rijeke („Službene novine Grada Rijeke“ broj 4. – godina XII): - završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku,
  • presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 10. rujna 2026. godine. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro insegnante di classe al doposcuola in lingua italiana – orario completo, a tempo indeterminato – 2 persone, con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), in conformità al Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20) e secondo la Decisione sull'organizzazione e sullo svolgimento del doposcuola e della scuola a tempo pieno nelle scuole elementari della Città di Fiume (Gazzetta ufficiale della Città di Fiume n. 4 – anno XII): - laurea - padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.
