title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport

 

The laboratory of Henrik Dimke, Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit at the Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark is seeking a highly motivated PhD student in the field of renal transport physiology. Particular emphasis will be placed on signalling through the calcium-sensing receptor and the regulation of renal calcium transport in transgenic models.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will join the laboratory of Professor Henrik Dimke in the Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit. The laboratory studies epithelial ion transport and the mechanisms that maintain calcium, magnesium, and phosphate balance, with particular emphasis on renal calcium transport, the calcium-sensing receptor, claudins, and kidney stone disease. The Research Unit focuses on innovative molecular and biomedical research related to cardiovascular and renal physiology. We offer a stimulating, international research environment where English is the preferred language at meetings and seminars. You will work in the modern NytSUND building, which is directly connected to the new Odense University Hospital and provides state-of-the-art laboratory and animal facilities. You can read more about the department and institute here.

 

Project description

The project will investigate how altered calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) signalling disrupts the endocrine and renal control of calcium homeostasis. Particular attention will be given to autosomal dominant hypocalcaemia type 1, in which excessive CASR activity suppresses parathyroid hormone secretion and promotes renal calcium loss. The project will examine the signalling mechanisms linking CASR activation to renal calcium transport and whole-body calcium balance. The successful applicant will use clinically relevant genetic models, including inducible and cell-specific transgenic approaches, together with detailed physiological characterization, molecular and biochemical techniques, and imaging.

 

Qualifications

Qualified and highly motivated candidates from all nationalities are encouraged to apply. 

 

The successful applicant must have

  • A Master's degree (Danish: kandidatgrad) or another relevant degree that concludes a research-based study programme of minimum five years’ duration at an institution of higher education. If you do not have a Master's degree, the Graduate School will make an individual assessment of your academic qualifications.

  • Good oral and written English language skills

  • you must at the time of submission have documented research experience. E.g. be the author or co-author of an article in a peer-reviewed international journal (must at least be submitted) or of a published abstract from an international scientific conference, or have worked as research assistant full time for at least 6 months (after completing your masters degree). The research experience of each applicant is individually assessed by the Graduate School.

 

The successful applicant should have

  • The ability to work independently and in a structured manner. 

  • Good collaborative and interpersonal skills. 

  • Previous experience with experimental animal work or relevant molecular and biochemical techniques, such as western blotting or immunohistochemistry, is preferred but not required.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:

Professor Henrik Dimke

Department of Molecular Medicine

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Tel. +45 65 50 83 10 E-mail: hdimke@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

• • Contact details for at least one professional reference who may be contacted during the assessment process.


Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. References will normally be contacted only for shortlisted candidates.

Further information about the PhD-program can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. 

 

Closing date: October 12th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

 

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

 

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner og opbygge batteritrailere. Vi har udvikling i Dragør og produktion på vores fabrik i Gedved, og vi tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til serieproduktion.

Som mekaniker/montør hos os arbejder du med den praktiske montage på produktionslinjen – primært opbygning af vores Vanteq, på sigt også entreprenørmaskiner og vores batteritrailer.

Produktionen er stadig ung, så der er masser af plads til at forbedre den. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, bidrager til problemløsning tidligt og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang. Dine typiske opgaver vil være:

●      Montage af Vanteq på produktionslinjen – efter fastlagte arbejdsinstruktioner

●      Montering af elektriske komponenter, kabelføring og drivline i chassis og karosseri

●      Sammen holder vi altid produktionen organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret for at sikre den højest mulige kvalitet.

Er det dig?

Vi leder efter en person med solid praktisk erfaring og en tilgang, der kombinerer præcision med fleksibilitet. Vigtigst er, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også er dygtig til at samarbejde i et team, der hele tiden lærer og udvikler sig. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan nikke ja til nedenstående:

●      Erfaring med montering og demontering af motor, hydrauliksystem og brændstofkomponenter på landbrugsmaskiner, entreprenørmaskiner eller varebiler

●      Solidt kendskab til mekaniske systemer, væskesystemer og elektriske grundelementer

●      AC-kursus eller tilsvarende (ikke obligatorisk, men en stor fordel)

●      Evnen til at arbejde struktureret og dokumentere dit arbejde

●      Selvstændighed og ansvar, men også åbenhed over for feedback og samarbejde

●      Tålmodighed og en positiv tilgang til arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor vi hele tiden forfiner processen

●      Dansk på højt niveau; fungerende engelsk er en fordel, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

●      En central rolle i vores produktionsteam, hvor din praktiske viden sætter direkte aftryk på, hvordan vi konverterer maskiner

●      Mulighed for at påvirke og udforme arbejdsprocesserne – dine idéer og erfaringer bliver hørt

●      En fast rytme i produktionen med arbejde på Vanteq og på sigt flere maskintyper

●      Tæt samarbejde med dygtige ingeniører og et uformelt, kollegialt team

●      Ordentlige faciliteter, godt værktøj og en støttende arbejdskultur

●      Løn: 190-240 kr./t afhængig af kompetencer og erfaring

title: Become a Night Shift Scooter Courier for dao in Kolding
description:
Do you live in Kolding or nearby? Now is your chance to become a carrier for night distribution, enjoy freedom and fast-paced work!

At dao we need employees for a temporary position to deliver parcels, magazines and letters. If you enjoy freedom with responsibility, working independently in all kinds of weather, we would love to have you on board!

At dao, you will get:

  • A temporary night job with shifts starting from 01:00 AM

  • Thorough training from day one and a supportive community 

About the role
Before you start, you will be invited to a mandatory onboarding day and receive training to feel confident in your role. During your shift you will:

  • Pack your scooter with, newspapers, letters, parcels and magazines.

  • Follow your route and deliver to doors and mailboxes

  • Keep a good pace and meet deadlines

The perfect candidate
If you can say yes to the following points, we would love to hear from you:

  • I am fluent in English or Danish

  • I can attend the onboarding day in Vejle (The onboarding day is usually held on Tuesdays. If you are hired, we will agree on the specific date with you.)

  • I can work at least 2-5 Nights a week

  • I hold a valid driver's license and are comfortable with scooter

  • I enjoy working in all kinds of weather

  • I am steady, responsible, and work with care and accuracy

The fine print
The salary is 132 DKK/hour + 27 DKK/hour night shift allowance and 10% fritvalg. DAO will provide vehicles.

Ready to become our new carrier?
Then click "Apply" and attach your application and CV.

We encourage everyone, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, sexual, political and cultural orientation, to apply for the job with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Har du el-teknisk baggrund og kendskab til fordelingstavler, så mangler vi dig!
description:
Vær med til at bygge fremtidens fordelingstavler hos Pro-Automatic!

Hos Pro-Automatic oplever vi stor aktivitet, og derfor søger vi flere faglærte el-tekniske medarbejdere med erfaring inden for opbygning og montage af fordelingstavler i Holsted.

Har du en stærk el-teknisk forståelse, og motiveres du af at levere kvalitetsløsninger? Trives du i et fagligt stærkt miljø, hvor godt håndværk, samarbejde og høj kvalitet er i fokus? Så er du måske vores nye tavlemontør.


Hvem er du?

Du er faglært elektriker, automatiktekniker, el-installatør eller har en anden relevant el-teknisk baggrund.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med opbygning og montage af fordelingstavler
  • Kan læse og forstå el-diagrammer og teknisk dokumentation
  • Arbejder struktureret og kvalitetsbevidst
  • Trives med både selvstændige opgaver og teamwork
  • Er ansvarsbevidst, mødestabil og har fokus på at levere et godt resultat
  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og den gode stemning på arbejdspladsen

Du får hos os
  • En alsidig hverdag med spændende faglige udfordringer
  • Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads i en dansk, ejerledet virksomhed med korte beslutningsveje
  • Dygtige kolleger og et stærkt fællesskab præget af hjælpsomhed og humor
  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår med løn efter kvalifikationer, pension og sundhedsforsikring
  • Kantineordning med både morgenmad og frokost

Hvorfor vælge Pro-Automatic?

Hos Pro-Automatic bliver du en del af et hold, der er stolte af deres faglighed og løsningerne vi leverer. Vores succes bygger på dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere, som hver dag gør en forskel for vores kunder.

Her får du mulighed for at bringe din faglighed i spil, tage ansvar og være med til at skabe løsninger af høj kvalitet til både danske og internationale kunder.


Klar til næste skridt?

Send din ansøgning og CV via knappen "Søg stillingen" eller kontakt produktionsleder Jesper Voss Hansen for at høre mere om jobbet.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.


Til rekrutteringsbureauer

Tak for interessen i at hjælpe os med rekrutteringen.

For at give vores rekrutterende ledere arbejdsro beder vi jer undlade at kontakte dem direkte. Har I en kandidat, der matcher stillingen, er I meget velkomne til at kontakte HR Manager Annette Sølund på ask@pro-automatic.dk eller 48 88 21 50.

title: Lageroperatør til varemodtagelsen (daghold)
description:
Har du solid erfaring med truckkørsel, og vil du være en del af et stærkt team på en stabil arbejdsplads med ambitiøse planer for fremtiden? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i varemodtagelsen hos ABENA Produktion.

Du bliver en del af et engageret daghold bestående af 10 lageroperatører. Vi arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar for vores opgaver og hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det. Du bliver en vigtig del af et team, hvor tillid, samarbejde og ordentlighed er centrale værdier.

Vi oplever høj aktivitet og udvider derfor teamet med en ny kollega. Samtidig investerer vi markant i fremtidens produktion og øger kapaciteten i de kommende år. Du bliver dermed en del af en virksomhed med langsigtede ambitioner og høj stabilitet.

Som lageroperatør i varemodtagelsen er din vigtigste opgave at sikre, at råvarer og emballage modtages, kontrolleres og indlagres korrekt, så produktionen kan køre effektivt.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • udføre modtagekontrol og indgangskontrol

  • modtage og ankomstmelde interne og eksterne biler

  • læsse og tømme biler med råvarer og emballage

  • føre palleregnskab

  • gennemføre optællinger

  • håndtere afvigelser

  • sikre orden og struktur i lagerområdet

  • løse ad hoc-opgaver i afdelingen

Du ansættes på fast daghold. Der kan dog i perioder forekomme arbejde på skiftehold.

Arbejdstiderne er: mandag til onsdag: kl. 06.00-14.35, torsdag: kl. 06.00-14.20, fredag: kl. 06.00-13.00.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • har erfaring fra et lignende job og flere års erfaring med truckkørsel

  • er fortrolig med at bruge PC som arbejdsredskab

  • behersker dansk i skrift og tale

  • arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • bidrager positivt til samarbejdet i teamet

  • Kendskab til ERP-systemet SAP er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Din kommende leder fortæller

"Som lagermedarbejder værdsætter jeg frihed under ansvar. Det er afgørende, at vi tager ejerskab for vores arbejdsdag, både i udvikling og i vedligeholdelse af rutiner. Når man arbejder med mennesker, er tillid, retfærdighed og samarbejde fundamentet for et godt arbejdsmiljø. Kommunikationen er central, og vi taler til hinanden med respekt og ligeværd." - Bo Hansen, Afdelingsleder Lager

Derfor skal du vælge ABENA

Hos ABENA bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi investerer i fremtiden, udvikler vores produktion og skaber rammerne for langsigtet vækst. Samtidig får du hverdagen i et stærkt team, hvor der er plads til både ansvar, faglighed og godt humør. Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • frihed under ansvar

  • engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • kantineordning

  • motionsrum

  • sundhedsordning

  • en række attraktive personalegoder

Hos os skal det være sjovt at gå på arbejde. Samtidig sætter vi en ære i at være ordentlige over for hinanden, vores leverandører og naturen.

Ansøgning

Er du klar til at blive en del af holdet? Send din ansøgning og dit CV ved at klikke på "Ansøg".

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Bo Hansen, Afdelingsleder Lager, på telefon 28939917.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Site Manager Isolering Danmark (m/k/d) - Site Manager Insulation - Site Manager Isolierung – Dänemark (m/w/d) Denmark (m/f/d) -
description:
See desription in English below

Siehe Beschreibung auf Deutsch unten

Dansk:

TL Concept er en veletableret produktions- og entreprenørvirksomhed, der er specialiseret i teknisk isolering, pladekapper, ventilationskanaler og brandbeskyttelse. Med mange års erfaring og ca. 600 dygtige medarbejdere, leverer vi løsninger af høj tysk kvalitet til byggeprojekter i hele Europa. TL Concept oplever stærk vækst, og Danmark er et af vores strategiske vækstområder. Vi har etableret et dansk selskab med dansk ledelse. www.tlconcept.eu      

 

Vi er kendt for vores fokus på innovation, præcision og en kundecentreret tilgang. Vores mål er at skabe bæredygtige og effektive løsninger, der lever op til vores kunders krav om kvalitet, samtidig med at vi sikrer et sikkert og inspirerende arbejdsmiljø for vores medarbejdere. Hos TL Concept er vi stolte af vores stærke teamkultur, hvor samarbejde og udvikling er i centrum. Vi tror på, at motiverede medarbejdere skaber de bedste resultater, og derfor prioriterer vi uddannelse og personlig udvikling.

 

Vi søger en engageret Site Manager Isolering til vores team. Hos os får du mulighed for spille en nøglerolle i store byggeprojekter, der involverer teknisk isolering, pladebeklædning, ventilationskanaler og passiv brandbeskyttelse

 

Som Site Manager bliver du ansvarlig for at drive vores byggeprojekter fremad. Du kommer til at spille en central rolle i at sikre udførelse af høj kvalitet, effektiv projektstyring og sikkerhed på byggepladsen. Du arbejder tæt sammen med et team på ca. 15 isolatører og montører, og din arbejdsdag vil være præget af ansvar og variation.

 

VI TILBYDER

·   Et ansvarsfuldt og afvekslende job i en dynamisk virksomhed med vindermentalitet

·   Ansættelse efter dansk lov i dansk datterselskab

·   Ægte holdånd, åben kommunikation og uformel arbejdsatmosfære

·   Professionelle processer og korte beslutningsveje

·   Firmabil og firmabetalt mobiltelefon

·   Løn efter kvalifikationer og mulighed for sundhedsforsikring

·   Løbende videreuddannelse og spændende projekter

 

FAGLIGE OG PERSONLIGE FORUDSÆTNINGER

·   Flere års erfaring som Site Manager inden for byggeledelse

·   Erfaring med montering – særligt af teknisk isolering, og gerne pladekapper, ventilation og brandbeskyttelse

·   Serviceorienteret, pålidelig og i stand til at motivere både sig selv og medarbejdere

·   Ansvarlig og kvalitetsbevidst , loyal, ærlig og vindende personlighed

·   Villig til at rejse til aktuelle byggeprojekter i Danmark (vi har aktuelt projekter på Sjælland 1 år frem)

·   Taler min. et af de skandinaviske sprog og engelsk. Kan du tysk er det et plus, men ikke et krav

·   Arbejdstilladelse i EU samt kørekort (kategori B)

·   Erfaren bruger af Office-pakken

 

DINE OPGAVER

·   Byggeledelse: Herunder koordinering af projekter og deadlines, ordrebehandling og materialeplanlægning, fakturerings- og økonomisk ansvar og daglig overblik over montagepersonale

·   Arbejdsmiljø og sikkerhed: Herunder sikre orden og sikkerhed på byggepladserne, overholde arbejdsmiljøregler og koordinere ferieplanlægning

·   Uddannelse og vejledning: Herunder uddanne, evaluere og udvikle teknisk personale i samarbejde med Projektlederen

·   Kvalitet og kommunikation: Herunder løbende overvågning og forbedring af kvalitet og produktivitet samt sikre god kommunikation og støtte til kunder og projektleder

Send dit fyldestgørende ansøgningsmateriale på dansk engelsk eller tysk per e-mail, inklusive cv, lønforventning og tilgængelighed, til Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu

 

For spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Jørgen per e-mail.

 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

English:

TL Concept is a well-established manufacturing and contracting company specialising in technical insulation, sheet metal cladding, ventilation ducts and fire protection. With many years of experience and approx. 600 skilled employees, we deliver solutions of high German quality to construction projects throughout Europe. TL Concept is experiencing strong growth, and Denmark is one of our strategic growth areas. We have established a Danish company with Danish management. www.tlconcept.eu

We are known for our focus on innovation, precision and a customer-centric approach. Our goal is to create sustainable and efficient solutions that fulfil our customers' demands for quality while ensuring a safe and inspiring work environment for our employees. At TL Concept, we are proud of our strong team culture, where collaboration and development take centre stage. We believe that motivated employees create the best results, which is why we prioritise training and personal development.

We are looking for a dedicated Site Manager Insulation to join our team. With us, you will have the opportunity to play a key role in large construction projects involving technical insulation, cladding, ventilation ducts and passive fire protection

As a Site Manager, you will be responsible for driving our construction projects forward. You will play a key role in ensuring high-quality execution, efficient project management and safety on site. Working closely with a team of around 15 insulators and fitters, your working day will be characterised by responsibility and variety.

WE OFFER

·   A responsible and varied job in a dynamic company with a winning mentality

·   Employment under Danish law in a Danish subsidiary

·   True team spirit, open communication and an informal working atmosphere

·   Professional processes and short decision-making processes

·   Company car and company-paid mobile phone.

·   Salary according to qualifications and the option of health insurance

·   Continuous training and exciting projects

 

PROFESSIONAL & PERSONAL PREREQUISITES

·   Several years of experience as a Site Manager in construction management

·   Experience in installation - especially technical insulation, and preferably sheet metal cladding, ventilation and fire protection

·   Service-orientated, reliable and able to motivate yourself and staff

·   Responsible and quality-conscious, loyal, honest and winning personality

·   Willing to travel to current construction projects in Denmark (we currently have projects on Zealand 1 year ahead)

·   Speaks min. one of the Scandinavian languages and English. German is a plus, but not a requirement

·   EU work permit and driving licence (category B)

·   Experienced user of Microsoft (Office, Excel, PowerPoint e.g.)

 

YOUR TASKS

·   Construction management: incl. coordination of projects and deadlines, order processing and material planning, invoicing and financial responsibility and daily overview of assembly staff

·   Health & safety: Incl. ensuring order and safety on construction sites, complying with health and safety regulations and coordinating holiday planning

·   Education & supervision: Incl. training, evaluating and developing technical staff in co-operation with the Project Manager

·   Quality & communication: Incl. continuous monitoring and improvement of quality and productivity as well as ensuring good communication and support to customers and project manager

Send your complete application material in Danish, English or German by email, including CV, salary expectations and availability, to Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu

For questions, you are welcome to contact Jørgen by e-mail.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Deutsch:

TL Concept ist ein etabliertes Produktions- und Bauunternehmen, das sich auf technische Isolierungen, Blechverkleidungen, Lüftungskanäle und Brandschutz spezialisiert hat. Mit langjähriger Erfahrung und ca. 600 qualifizierten Mitarbeitern liefern wir Lösungen von hoher deutscher Qualität für Bauprojekte in ganz Europa. TL Concept befindet sich in einem starken Wachstumsprozess, und Dänemark ist eines unserer strategischen Wachstumsgebiete. Wir haben ein dänisches Unternehmen mit dänischem Management gegründet. www.tlconcept.eu .

Wir sind bekannt für unseren Fokus auf Innovation, Präzision und einen kundenzentrierten Ansatz. Unser Ziel ist es, nachhaltige und effiziente Lösungen zu schaffen, die die Qualitätsanforderungen unserer Kunden erfüllen und gleichzeitig ein sicheres und inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter gewährleisten. Bei TL Concept sind wir stolz auf unsere starke Teamkultur, in der Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung im Mittelpunkt stehen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass motivierte Mitarbeiter die besten Ergebnisse erzielen. Deshalb legen wir großen Wert auf Weiterbildung und persönliche Entwicklung.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Site Manager Isolierung. Bei uns haben Sie die Möglichkeit, eine Schlüsselrolle bei großen Bauprojekten in den Bereichen technische Isolierung, Verkleidung, Lüftungskanäle und passiver Brandschutz zu spielen.

Als Site Manager sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, unsere Bauprojekte voranzutreiben. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gewährleistung einer qualitativ hochwertigen Ausführung, eines effizienten Projektmanagements und der Sicherheit auf der Baustelle. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem Team von rund 15 Isolierern und Monteuren wird Ihr Arbeitsalltag von Verantwortung und Abwechslung geprägt sein.

WIR BIETEN 

·   Eine verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen Unternehmen mit Gewinnermentalität

·   Eine Anstellung nach dänischem Recht in einer dänischen Tochtergesellschaft

·   Echten Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und eine ungezwungene Arbeitsatmosphäre

·   Professionelle Prozesse und kurze Entscheidungswege

·   Firmenwagen und ein vom Unternehmen bezahltes Mobiltelefon.

·   Ein Gehalt, das der Qualifikation entspricht, und die Möglichkeit einer Krankenversicherung

·   Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und spannende Projekte

 

FACHLICHE & PERSÖNLICHE VORAUSSETZUNGEN

·   Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Bauleiter im Baumanagement

·   Erfahrung im Montagebereich - insbesondere technische Isolierung, vorzugsweise Blechverkleidung, Lüftung und Brandschutz

·   Serviceorientiert, zuverlässig und in der Lage, sich selbst und Mitarbeiter zu motivieren

·   Verantwortungsvolle und qualitätsbewusste, loyale, ehrliche und gewinnende Persönlichkeit

·   Bereitschaft, zu aktuellen Bauprojekten in Dänemark zu reisen (wir haben derzeit Projekte auf Seeland, die 1 Jahr vor uns liegen)

·   Spricht mindestens eine der skandinavischen Sprachen und Englisch. Deutsch ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung

·   EU-Arbeitserlaubnis und Führerschein (Kategorie B)

·   Erfahrener Anwender von Microsoft (Office, Excel, PowerPoint u.a.)

 

IHRE AUFGABEN

·   Baumanagement: inkl. Projekt- und Terminkoordination, Auftragsabwicklung und Materialdisposition, Rechnungsstellung und Finanzverantwortung sowie täglicher Überblick über das Montagepersonal

·   Gesundheit & Sicherheit: Inkl. Sicherstellung von Ordnung und Sicherheit auf den Baustellen, Einhaltung der Arbeitsschutzbestimmungen und Koordination der Urlaubsplanung

·   Ausbildung & Betreuung: Schulung, Bewertung und Entwicklung des technischen Personals in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Projektleiter

·   Qualität & Kommunikation: Inkl. kontinuierliche Überwachung und Verbesserung von Qualität und Produktivität sowie Sicherstellung einer guten Kommunikation und Unterstützung von Kunden und Projektmanager

Senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen in Dänisch, Englisch oder Deutsch per E-Mail mit Lebenslauf, Gehaltsvorstellungen und Verfügbarkeit an Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu .

Bei Fragen können Sie sich gerne per E-Mail an Jørgen wenden.

title: Praktisk stærk servicemedarbejder til MARTECs brandskole i HVIMS
employer: Den selvejende institution MARTEC - Maritime and Polytechnic College
description:
Er du praktisk anlagt, serviceorienteret og god til at skabe struktur i en hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver? MARTEC søger en servicemedarbejder med en håndværksmæssig baggrund til vores brandskole HVIMS.

Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og skal være med til at sikre, at brandskolens bygninger, øvelsesområder og udstyr fremstår funktionelle, sikre og klar til undervisning og kursusaktiviteter.

Om stillingen

Som servicemedarbejder på MARTECs brandskole får du en alsidig og praktisk hverdag. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med brandskolens instruktører og øvrige medarbejdere og får en central rolle i forbindelse med klargøring, drift og vedligeholdelse.

Arbejdsopgaverne varierer fra dag til dag. Du skal derfor trives med en hverdag, hvor der både er planlagte vedligeholdelsesopgaver og opgaver, som skal løses med kort varsel. Stillingen kræver, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage initiativ og bidrage aktivt til at få de daglige aktiviteter til at fungere.

Dine opgaver

Dine primære opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • klargøre øvelsesområder og udstyr til undervisning og kursusaktiviteter

  • rydde op og genetablere øvelsesområder efter gennemførte aktiviteter

  • udføre løbende drift og vedligeholdelse af bygninger, udendørsarealer og teknisk udstyr

  • udføre mindre håndværksmæssige reparationer og praktiske opgaver

  • vedligeholde og reparere metaldele og udstyr, herunder eventuelt udføre mindre svejseopgaver

  • planlægge vedligeholdelsesopgaver og følge op på arbejde udført af eksterne håndværkere

  • bidrage til korrekt og bæredygtig affaldshåndtering

  • hjælpe instruktørerne med praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med brandskolens aktiviteter


Kvalifikationer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en faglært håndværksmæssig baggrund og erfaring med praktisk vedligeholdelse. Din konkrete uddannelse er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste er, at du har en bred praktisk forståelse, kan bruge dine hænder og er indstillet på at løse mange forskellige typer opgaver.

Det er en fordel, hvis du:

  • har erfaring med bygningsdrift, vedligeholdelse eller tekniske installationer

  • kan udføre mindre svejseopgaver

  • har truckcertifikat

  • har kørekort til lastbil og eventuelt bus

  • har grundlæggende IT-kundskaber

Kørekort til personbil er en forudsætning.
Du skal være indstillet på at arbejde i et miljø, hvor undervisningen blandt andet omfatter praktiske brandøvelser. Arbejdet kan derfor foregå både indendørs og udendørs og vil til tider være fysisk krævende.

Om dig

Vi søger en kollega, der motiveres af at yde god service og selvstændigt løse hverdagens praktiske udfordringer.

Som person er du:

  • selvkørende og struktureret i din tilgang til opgaverne

  • fleksibel i forhold til både arbejdstider og arbejdsopgaver

  • praktisk anlagt og god til at finde løsninger

  • ansvarsbevidst, stabil og engageret

  • samarbejdsorienteret og klar til at hjælpe, hvor der er behov

  • god til at kommunikere med instruktører, kursister og kolleger

  • åben over for nye udfordringer og interesseret i at udvikle dig fagligt og personligt

Vi tilbyder

Du får en spændende og alsidig stilling i et unikt undervisningsmiljø, hvor du får stor indflydelse på din egen hverdag. Du bliver en del af et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger, hvor samarbejde, faglighed og respekt for hinanden vægtes højt.

Vi tilbyder desuden gode ansættelsesforhold og mulighed for relevant faglig udvikling.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling med arbejdssted på MARTECs brandskole HVIMS, men vi er åbne for at aftale et lavere timetal med den rette kandidat. Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst.
Tiltrædelse aftales nærmere.

Ansøgning

Afdelingschef Jan Jacobsen Mobil: 25 58 19 60 E-mail: jfj@martec.dk

title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon i Trekantsområdet
description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

 

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

 

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

 

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

 

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Derfor er det ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

 

Med udgangspunkt fra en eller flere af vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fabriksleder Tobias Meier Jørgensen på telefon 2871 4678 eller områdechef Kent Florczak på telefon 29254481.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

 

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

title: Seasonal Worker wanted with forklift certificate – for the pumpkin season 2026
description:
About Thorsbjerggaard

Thorsbjerggaard is a Danish farm specializing in the cultivation of edible pumpkins. Our products are supplied to many major Danish supermarkets and specialty stores. We also grow peas, squash, and watermelons.

All work is carried out on the farm, including cultivation, harvesting, washing, and packing.

A valid forklift certificate is an advantage and will be preferred.

The certificate must be valid for use in Europe.

Only applicants with a forklift certificate will be considered for the position.

Working Period

As soon as possible – end of March 2027

Working Hours

During warm periods, work usually starts at 5:00 a.m. and continues until around 12:00 noon. During busy periods, additional work in the afternoon may be required.

Working hours may vary depending on the weather and workload. Part-time work may occur. You will have at least one day off per week.

Language Requirements

You must be able to speak and understand English.

Wages

Monthly salary

Registered with the Danish tax authorities (SKAT)

Salary paid directly into your bank account, with a pay slip

Requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old.

  • EU citizenship (a valid passport or national ID card is required).

  • Good physical condition, motivation, and a positive attitude.

  • Farm or harvesting experience is an advantage but not required.

  • A clean criminal record certificate from your home country.

We Expect You To

  • Be reliable and arrive on time.

  • Be flexible and willing to help wherever needed.

  • Work well as part of a team with people from different cultures.

  • Be able to communicate in English.

Accommodation

We have a campsite located on the farm, where you can rent a space in a caravan. Each caravan can accommodate up to four people.

Beds with mattresses are provided, but you must bring your own sleeping bag and bed linen.

The campsite offers access to toilets, showers, laundry facilities, shared cooking facilities (you prepare your own meals), and internet access.

The accommodation fee is all-inclusive.

The cost of accommodation in a caravan is DKK 70 per person per day. A refundable deposit of DKK 1,500 is required and will be returned if everything is left in the same condition as when you arrived.

Holiday Allowance

Holiday allowance will be transferred to FerieKonto and paid according to Danish holiday regulations.

Hygiene Rules

All hygiene regulations relating to the handling and harvesting of food products must be strictly followed. You will receive detailed instructions before starting work.

Failure to follow the hygiene rules may result in immediate dismissal without further warning.

What to Bring

  • Please remember to bring:

  • Sleeping bag

  • Warm clothing

  • Practical work clothes

  • Boots and waterproof clothing

  • Even in good weather, the plants can be very wet in the morning.

Important Documents

You must bring:

  • A valid national ID card (and passport, if possible)

  • A valid IBAN bank account in your own name

  • Documentation proving that you have health insurance in your home country

  • Tax Information 2026

  • You must bring documentation showing that you have a permanent address in your home country.

  • If you worked for us last year and have had other jobs since then, please bring documentation from your most recent employer.

  • If you are married, documentation of your marital status is required.

  • Please bring copies of all original documents, as well as English translations.

How to Apply

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@thorsbjerggaard.dk

If you do not hear from us within two weeks, please assume that your application was unsuccessful and that we are unable to offer you a position for 2026.

You will not be responsible for deciding or setting sales prices. Sales prices are determined by the Store Manager. Your responsibility will be to check that the prices and information have been entered correctly.

title: Assistant Professor in High Frequency Switch-Mode Power Supplies
description:
The Digital and High-Frequency Electronics (DHFE) section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, based at the university campus in Odense, seeks outstanding individuals for full-time Assistant Professor positions in Power Electronics, focusing on power management for electronic and computing devices and systems. Successful applicants are expected to contribute to the development of academic programs and the research community. Applicants should have a PhD in Power Electronics or a closely related field. 

The DHFE section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

Applicants are expected to establish and maintain a research program in high-frequency power electronics and power management for computation, along with low-voltage electronic systems. The position emphasizes converter and power-management for computing platforms and resource-constrained applications, including battery-operated, energy-harvesting, mobile, autonomous, embedded, and sensor-based systems.

The section is a vital component of our Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Science, and Master of Science programs in Electrical and Electronics Engineering in Odense. Currently, the section focuses on three research fields: 1) Drones for Infrastructure Inspections and Interactions, 2) High-Frequency SMPS and power management for low-power electronic systems, and 3) Telecommunication Systems. The section has 15 academics, including professors, postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, and engineers, to support research, industrial collaboration, and educational activities, and is growing steadily.

The SDU campus in Odense contains six faculties and soon a large university hospital, creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich, surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community, and highly livable with a green-banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas.

 

Job Description

The position focuses on power management for resource-constrained autonomous, mobile, and embedded electronic systems. Relevant research areas include high-frequency power conversion, battery-operated systems, energy harvesting, power management architectures, embedded control, and analog/digital control of converters. The application domain spans from ultra-low-power electronics and sensors to mobile platforms, robotics, drones, IoT devices, and power management for embedded, compact, and high-performance computing systems.

The role strengthens DHFE’s research profile at the interface between power electronics, microelectronics, embedded systems, and intelligent electronic devices. It is expected to support shared research themes across SDU, including energy-efficient electronics, autonomous systems, battery-powered platforms, sensor networks, health technology, and miniaturized or distributed devices.

The successful candidate should work constructively both with colleagues within DHFE and also with colleagues from other research units, such as SDU Microelectronics, SDU Centre for Industrial Electronics, the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, Faculty of Health (specifically Health Tech), Mechanical Engineering, and other relevant environments, translating power electronics competence into system-level contributions for electronic devices and platforms.

 

Duties

As a faculty member, you will be responsible for developing and delivering undergraduate and graduate teaching in Electronic and Electrical Engineering, with particular attention to strengthening control and power electronics within the BSc portfolio. This includes supervising students at Bachelor and Master’s level, mentoring students, integrating with the student body, and participating in education and outreach activities. Research duties include establishing an externally funded research agenda, publishing in leading journals and conferences, supervising early-career researchers, and contributing to the development of DHFE’s research environment. The candidate is also expected to contribute to external collaboration and perform service at the section, department, university, and professional levels.

 

Qualifications Required

  • The applicant should hold a doctoral degree (PhD) in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a related subject area. 

  • Demonstrated potential for teaching undergraduate and graduate courses at the university level. 

  • The applicant must have relevant research expertise in areas related to efficient and high-frequency power converters, converter control, and power management for computing or embedded electronic systems.

  • The applicant must have teaching skills that align with the content and responsibilities of the position. This includes possessing both pedagogical and professional skills essential for carrying out the tasks associated with the role. 

  • A strong track record for research fundraising is required. 

 

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tim McRae (mcrae@sdu.dk)  or the Head of the Digital and High-frequency Electronics Section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

  • Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must be in English and include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing the research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, etc.

  • A research plan with a focus on the development of your research line and research team. 

  • List of funded projects. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • List of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted. 

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.) 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

  

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. The final start date will be agreed with the successful applicant.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
Want to work with sustainability and software? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you.

We are looking for a software developer to join us to develop and maintain our digital platforms as we scale.

We do drone-based emissions monitoring across oil & gas, maritime, waste management, and other industries. By helping operators safely identify methane leaks and quantify emissions, we're proud to be supporting industry efforts to improve environmental performance while enhancing operational efficiency and asset integrity. We measure greenhouse gas emissions data from various sources and combining them with atmospheric data. Based on scientific methods we then quantify emissions and visualize the data to provide emissions intelligence to operations enabling actions on emissions.

We have a strong focus on R&D, and we are exploring new cutting-edge technologies and ideas to innovate what we can do within emissions monitoring.

The job

You will be part of a small, talented tech developer team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our digital platforms, which are the core of the products we deliver to customers.

As a Software Developer your responsibilities will include:

  • Co-development of our main applications Microsoft Azure, Blazor Server Application (C#)

  • Co-development of our calculation engine, Microsoft Azure Function (Python)

  • Develop new, more appealing user experiences aimed at different user groups to view products and services.

  • Maintain databases, application services and reporting landscape specific to the European maritime emission monitoring set-up.

  • Improve analysis tools and the user experience for the customers, the drone pilot and the internal project manager in collaboration with the project manager running the campaigns.

About you

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

  • A bachelor's degree or master’s degree in engineering, data science, software design, computer engineering, mathematics, physics or similar

  • Experience with code development in C# and Python and preferable Rust

  • Experience with database design (SQL)

  • Familiar with software development processes in Azure DevOps

  • Experience with development of user interfaces and UX design is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Fluent in English. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Genuine interest in technology and IT infrastructure

  • Structured and focused on delivering quality work and being a good team player.

 

What we offer

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact on cutting industrial emissions

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance

  • Software ownership early on, with senior developers to learn from

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early

  • A supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning

  • Job location is just north of Copenhagen in Virum, Denmark.

Application and information

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we will be evaluating applications on an ongoing basis. Application deadline is 18 October 2026. Expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Please send your application, including your motivation and what a competence you bring, together with your CV to jobs@explicit.dk. Write “Software developer” in the subject field.

If you have any questions about the job, you are welcome to contact Rasmus Ebdrup, Chief Digital Officer at reb@explicit.dk

___________________________________________________________________________________

About Explicit

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish green tech company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industries. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology.

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport

 

The laboratory of Henrik Dimke, Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit at the Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark is seeking a highly motivated PhD student in the field of renal transport physiology. Particular emphasis will be placed on signalling through the calcium-sensing receptor and the regulation of renal calcium transport in transgenic models.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will join the laboratory of Professor Henrik Dimke in the Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit. The laboratory studies epithelial ion transport and the mechanisms that maintain calcium, magnesium, and phosphate balance, with particular emphasis on renal calcium transport, the calcium-sensing receptor, claudins, and kidney stone disease. The Research Unit focuses on innovative molecular and biomedical research related to cardiovascular and renal physiology. We offer a stimulating, international research environment where English is the preferred language at meetings and seminars. You will work in the modern NytSUND building, which is directly connected to the new Odense University Hospital and provides state-of-the-art laboratory and animal facilities. You can read more about the department and institute here.

 

Project description

The project will investigate how altered calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) signalling disrupts the endocrine and renal control of calcium homeostasis. Particular attention will be given to autosomal dominant hypocalcaemia type 1, in which excessive CASR activity suppresses parathyroid hormone secretion and promotes renal calcium loss. The project will examine the signalling mechanisms linking CASR activation to renal calcium transport and whole-body calcium balance. The successful applicant will use clinically relevant genetic models, including inducible and cell-specific transgenic approaches, together with detailed physiological characterization, molecular and biochemical techniques, and imaging.

 

Qualifications

Qualified and highly motivated candidates from all nationalities are encouraged to apply. 

 

The successful applicant must have

  • A Master's degree (Danish: kandidatgrad) or another relevant degree that concludes a research-based study programme of minimum five years’ duration at an institution of higher education. If you do not have a Master's degree, the Graduate School will make an individual assessment of your academic qualifications.

  • Good oral and written English language skills

  • you must at the time of submission have documented research experience. E.g. be the author or co-author of an article in a peer-reviewed international journal (must at least be submitted) or of a published abstract from an international scientific conference, or have worked as research assistant full time for at least 6 months (after completing your masters degree). The research experience of each applicant is individually assessed by the Graduate School.

 

The successful applicant should have

  • The ability to work independently and in a structured manner. 

  • Good collaborative and interpersonal skills. 

  • Previous experience with experimental animal work or relevant molecular and biochemical techniques, such as western blotting or immunohistochemistry, is preferred but not required.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:

Professor Henrik Dimke

Department of Molecular Medicine

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Tel. +45 65 50 83 10 E-mail: hdimke@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

• • Contact details for at least one professional reference who may be contacted during the assessment process.


Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. References will normally be contacted only for shortlisted candidates.

Further information about the PhD-program can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. 

 

Closing date: October 12th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

 

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

 

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

description:
SDU CREATE invites highly motivated candidates who wish to contribute to a regenerative built environment to apply for one or more PhD positions in Computational Design and Fabrication for Living System Integration in Architecture. The position(s) is expected to begin in January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The application deadline is 15 October 2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Scope of the work

The PhD position(s) is linked to the Villum CEBE programme, Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment, funded by the Villum Foundation. Within Research Field 2, Design for Regeneration, Circularity and Longevity, the research will develop architectural interfaces that support the establishment and growth of living systems, particularly photosynthetic communities, as a strategy for regenerative architecture. The focus is on enveloping surfaces in the built environment.

The project will focus on designing, testing and demonstrating, at architectural scale, porous mineral interfaces combined with hydrogels. Computational design, fabrication and environmental monitoring will be combined with cultivation experiments and biological assessment, targeting mosses, algae and cyanobacteria in collaboration with partner researchers in biology.

We seek candidates with primary expertise in one of two complementary research profiles:

  • Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing: exploring how architectural geometry, material composition and 3D printing can create bioreceptive interfaces. The work will combine computational design, printable material development, toolpath generation and robot programming to develop porous mineral interfaces informed by biological requirements.

  • Living Material Design and Biological Performance: developing hydrogels incorporating living organisms for integration into porous mineral interfaces. The work will combine formulation, cultivation, sensors, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, biological growth, photosynthetic activity and material performance.

Both profiles require an interest in integrating biological systems and processes into architectural design and construction. The successful candidate(s) will collaborate within the team to develop and validate the resulting interfaces.

The candidate(s) will also contribute to the Centre’s activities, including teaching in the MSc CREATE programme and the BSc programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering through teaching, workshops and co-supervision of student projects.

Focus Area and Research Project

The research will investigate how material composition, porous morphologies and hygrothermal dynamics can support biological establishment and environmental performance, while addressing durability, maintenance and integration into building envelopes. Environmental measurements will help establish relationships between interface design, climatic exposure, biological development and performance.

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to selected areas according to their expertise, working within a team with complementary skills:

  • Computational design of bioreceptive mineral interfaces for enveloping surfaces in the built environment

  • Development and characterisation of printable mineral materials

  • Robotic 3D printing, toolpath generation and fabrication process development

  • Formulation of hydrogels incorporating living organisms and their integration into printed scaffolds

  • Cultivation experiments and assessment of biological growth and photosynthetic activity

  • Sensor integration, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, ecological and microclimatic performance

  • Fabrication and evaluation of full-scale architectural demonstrators, addressing durability, maintenance and sustained biological growth

About SDU CREATE’s Research Environment

The Centre for Computational Research in Emergent Architectural Technology and Engineering, SDU CREATE, is led by Associate Professor Roberto Naboni. The Centre investigates advanced concepts and applications in architectural engineering, focusing on computational design, construction robotics, and material innovation. SDU CREATE brings together an international research team working across architectural engineering, computer science, robotics, materials science, and biology. Its research develops sustainable, regenerative approaches to designing and constructing the built environment.

Located within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark, SDU CREATE provides advanced laboratory facilities for robotic fabrication, additive and subtractive manufacturing, mixed reality applications in design and construction, and structural and mechanical testing. The facilities include industrial robotic systems, computational design platforms, and equipment for the experimental testing of materials, components, and structures. This environment supports interdisciplinary collaboration and partnerships with academic and industrial institutions in Denmark and internationally. The candidate(s) will work within a research culture that combines computational development with physical experimentation and full scale construction.

SDU CREATE is a partner in CEBE, a ten-year national research initiative funded by the Villum Foundation, in which Danish technical universities collaborate to advance the sustainability of the built environment within planetary boundaries. Within this initiative, SDU CREATE leads research in Digitalisation and Automation, RF4, and contributes to research in Design for Regeneration, Circularity, and Longevity, RF2. The programme provides a long-term research framework, access to national research networks, and opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to the development and delivery of CREATE’s research activities and laboratory-based investigations. Responsibilities include:

  • Conducting high-quality research within the defined research project and contributing original, scientifically rigorous outcomes

  • Conducting fabrication experiments and biological and environmental performance testing, including operation of robotic systems and laboratory equipment as relevant to the candidate’s research profile

  • Participating in CREATE’s research team activities, contributing to the development of design, fabrication, and testing frameworks

  • Developing and maintaining computational tools and workflows supporting the research activities

  • Assisting in teaching bachelor’s and master’s level courses and workshops, including co-supervision of thesis students and collaboration with interns in research-related activities

  • Disseminating research results through high-impact peer-reviewed publications and recognised international conferences

  • Sharing research outcomes through curated and high-quality outputs for digital platforms, exhibitions, and competitions

  • Contributing to the further development and maintenance of CREATE’s laboratory infrastructures and experimental facilities

  • Engaging with academic and industrial collaborators at the national and international level, including participation in the Villum CEBE research network

  • Assisting senior staff in the preparation of applications for external research funding

Engagement in these activities will evolve with the experience of the candidate(s), contributing to the Centre’s excellence and supporting their academic development, ideally towards future career advancement.

Candidate Requirements

Applications are invited from highly motivated candidates holding a Master’s degree in architecture, computational design, civil or architectural engineering, materials science, environmental engineering, biology, or other relevant disciplines related to the research areas. Candidates must demonstrate primary expertise in either Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing or Living Material Design and Biological Performance, and the ability to contribute to shared design, fabrication and validation activities. Interdisciplinary experience connecting these areas is particularly valued.

Candidates must demonstrate:

  • Documented interest and foundational knowledge in bioreceptive design, living system integration or related research areas

  • Competence in Grasshopper and Rhino, advanced for the Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile and at working level for the Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile, together with relevant programming skills such as Python or C#

  • For the Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile: practical experience in computational design, toolpath generation and robotic 3D printing, together with an understanding of biological requirements relevant to design; experience developing porous geometries and printable mineral materials are particularly valued

  • For the Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile: practical experience in material formulation and biological experimentation or cultivation, together with competence in experimental measurement and data analysis; experience with hydrogels, sensor integration, automated monitoring or hygrothermal characterisation are particularly valued

  • Hands-on laboratory experience, including physical prototyping or specimen preparation, and experimental testing relevant to the selected profile

  • Demonstrated capacity to conduct, document and disseminate projects and research outcomes suitable for peer-reviewed publication

  • Strong proficiency in English, both written and oral

  • Strong ability to work effectively within interdisciplinary teams and to coordinate and collaborate daily

  • Strong communication skills across graphical, written and oral formats

  • A proven track record of involvement in research or innovation projects; experience in teaching assistance, peer-reviewed publications or engagement with academic or industry stakeholders is evaluated positively

Contact information

For further information about the position(s) and SDU CREATE’s activities, please contact the Head of Centre, Associate Professor Roberto Naboni, at ron@iti.sdu.dk. For additional information on the Centre’s work, visit the website at www.create-sdu.com. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Find full information about how to apply as well as assessment and employment terms on our website!

title: Postdoc Position (2 years) in Manufacturing Technology & Industrial Management
description:
The Department of Technology and Innovation (ITI) at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), section of Engineering Operations Management, invites applications for a 2-year position as Postdoc in Manufacturing Technology & Industrial Management.  The position is open from December 1, 2026, and the job location is Odense, Denmark.

 

Job description  

Successful candidates will drive internationally competitive research, collaborate in and across disciplines, work closely with industry and attract competitive external research and innovation funding in collaboration with senior researchers. The candidates will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervise students, and develop junior research staff. 

 

We offer 

We offer a vigorous international research environment with a balance of male and female researchers, excellent facilities, including the new Robotics and Additive Manufacturing Laboratories at University of Southern Denmark, a long-term strategic initiative created to support research, teaching, and industrial collaboration and experimentation. SDU expects to increase its’ collaboration with industrial companies and associations in the coming years. 

This position will imply collaboration with industrial partners in the Renewable Energy Sector. Examples can be vendors of wind turbines, electrification solutions, electrolyzers, biogas equipment, carbon capture, utilization and storage technologies etc. It can also be major owners / operators of renewable energy plants, as offshore wind turbine park operators, green hydrogen / methanol / ammonia plants etc.

Research will be done to support DK and EU in realizing ambitions for production of green energy at off-take prices competitive with energy from fossil fuels via scaling and industrialization, whether the energy is in the form of green electricity or green fuels for industry and transport. There will be specific emphasis on research into the interplay between business strategy, product design, manufacturing systems design, manufacturing technology choices and scenarios or plans for industrial scaling. In addition to that, the position offers the opportunity to shape our educational and research and innovation programs by contributing to teaching and supervision in areas of Manufacturing technologies of the future and Industrial Management to benefit from new developments in research fields, approaches and content.   

 

We expect 

Candidates must have a relevant PhD.

Commensurate with the seniority of the position applied for, the candidates must ideally have: 

  • An excellent standing in research and innovation

  • Documented experience and good track record with education and supervision on undergraduate or graduate level

  • Extensive experience with industrial collaboration: can be from working in partnerships with or within companies, but also industrial and NGO organizations 

  • Industry outreach and work experience will be assessed positively 

  • Research & innovation project management experience will be assessed positively 

  • International work experience, organizational drive and a team-oriented mindset

  • Good written and oral communication skills

  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written                   

Candidates must have experience and competence in several, but not all, of the following fields: 

  • Business, Manufacturing and Operations Strategy

  • Product / Service design for Manufacturing, Logistics and Sustainability

  • Systems Design and Engineering

  • Materials Science, Industrial processes & Future Manufacturing Technologies

  • Design, Operations & Maintenance of Manufacturing Systems

  • Lean Manufacturing / Logistics and Industry 4.0 / 5.0 

  • Discrete Event Simulation Methods, Agent Based Simulation & Technologies

  • Machine Learning, AI, LLMs & Data Science for Manufacturing and Supply Chain Operations

  • Cost-Benefit and Return of Investment Analysis

  • Life Cycle Analysis Methods 

  • Modelling and Simulation methods

  • Case study, Design Science, Action Research Methods

  • Project Management, Agile Methods, Scrum Methods

  • EU strategies and plan for decarbonization of industry and society 

  • UN Sustainability Goals and Dimensions,

Working experience from industry, also within the renewable energy sector, will be seen as positive add-on but is not a requirement to apply for the position.

Further information about the position may be obtained from Head of Section, Niels Gorm Maly Rytter, phone: +45 29103729 or email: ngry@iti.sdu.dk 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • Publications most relevant to the position on which the applicant wishes to rely on.

Should your referees wish to send their letters directly to us, please have them use e-mail: tek-hr@tek.sdu.dk mentioning your name and the title of the position in the subject line. Please note that these also need to reach us before deadline.
