title: Vi søker servicemedarbeider i helse og omsorg
description:
Vil du ha en meningsfull jobb der du bidrar til en tjeneste med orden, struktur og god atmosfære for ansatte, beboerne og deres pårørende?

Hva vi ser etter

Du kan gjerne ha erfaring fra renhold, kjøkken, hotell, butikk, lager, logistikk, service, helse eller annet praktisk arbeid. Formell helsefaglig utdanning er ikke nødvendig.

Det viktigste er at du er:

  • rolig, tålmodig og respektfull

  • selvstendig, pålitelig og ansvarsfull

  • praktisk anlagt og glad i orden

  • fleksibel og lærevillig

  • trygg i møte med mennesker

Mange av beboerne har langtkommen demens, og det er derfor viktig at du møter dem med ro, tålmodighet og respekt. Vi ønsker at du har gode norskkunnskaper.

Arbeidstid

Vi har behov for medarbeidere på ulike tidspunkt gjennom uken; på kveld, helg og dagtid året igjennom. Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidsoppgaver avtales ut fra behov og hvordan du best kan bidra i rollen.

Søknad

Fortell oss gjerne i søknaden hva du har erfaring med, hvilke oppgaver du kunne tenke deg og når du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi oppfordrer alle interesserte til å søke. Ikke vær redd for om du ikke treffer alle punktene. Vi er nysgjerrige på hva du kan bidra med.

Før tiltredelse: Godkjent og gyldig politiattest nyere enn 3 måneder. Negativ MRSA og tuberkulose-test. Taushetserklæring fylles ut første dag og gjelder også etter endt arbeidsforhold.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Elverhøy bokollektiv og Sagtomta bokollektiv (langtidsplass i institusjon for personer med demens og personer med skjermingsbehov) søker praktiske- og serviceinnstilte medarbeidere som kan avlaste helsepersonellet med oppgaver som ikke krever helsefaglig utdanning.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Arbeidsoppgavene tilpasses erfaringen din, hva du trives med og behovet på avdelingen. Du trenger derfor ikke kunne eller utføre alle oppgavene:

  • Tilberede og servere måltider, mating

  • Renhold og forefallende kjøkkenoppgaver før og etter måltider

  • Renhold av møblement inne/ute og hjelpemidler

  • Vanne blomster, støvtørking og avfallshåndtering

  • Klargjøring av rom mellom pasienter og mellom vaktskift

  • Orden og forefallende oppgaver på vaskerom

  • Håndtering og rydding av tekstiler/ bekledning

  • Orden og varepåfylling på lager

  • Logistikk: Hente og levere post, blodprøver, annet

  • Bistå kollega med å følge beboere til og fra aktiviteter

  • Bistå å være en trygghet for beboerne i fellesstua

Vi tilbyr

  • En tilpasset rolle basert på din kompetanse

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø

  • Muligheter for fast ansettelse etter prosjektets slutt

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vinn Hallingdal AS er rekrutteringspartner for Nesbyen kommune:

Nesbyen kommune Helse og omsorg

Nesbyen kommune er hjertet i Hallingdal, og ligger mellom Oslo og Bergen i Buskerud fylke. Kommunen har ca. 3 300 innbyggere, hvorav 2 100 innbyggere er bosatt i de sentrumsnære områdene. Det er et stort antall besøkende til kommunen som følge av store hytteområder.

Barnehagedekningen er god, vi har en av Norges beste grunnskoler og det er et variert skoletilbud innen videregående utdanning og fagskoler i Hallingdal. I kommunen er det et mangfold av frivillige organisasjoner for alle aldersgrupper og interesser. Mulighetene for en aktiv fritid er mange både innen idrett, friluftsliv og kultur (www.nesbyen.no). Kommunen er en av Norges mest attraktive sykkeldestinasjoner (www.trailhead.no). Med Bergensbanen og Rv. 7 som fartsårer, er kommunen lett tilgjengelig.

Finn ut mer om Nesbyen ved å se filmen Bo i Nesbyen

https://vimeo.com/528811190

title: Miljøterapeut i medleverstilling
description:
Vår flotte avdeling i bydel Alna har behov deg, som ønsker å arbeide i medleverturnus 3/7/4/7. En nyinnflyttet beboer ser etter deg som har erfaring med autisme diagnose, men evner å se menneske bak. Du er god på å arbeide med mennesker som er selvstendige i mye, men fortsatt har behov for innramming, struktur og veiledning i dagliglivets gjøremål. Hvis du i tillegg liker å være aktiv, og vil være med å trene er dette ett stort pluss.

I Humana jobber vi ut fra visjonen om at alle har rett til et godt liv, ja alle. Hver dag gjør våre ansatte en innsats som betyr alt for menneskene vi er her for. Som miljøterapeut hos oss blir du en helt avgjørende del av løsningen for enkeltmennesker og en uunnværlig partner for det offentlige.

Hva skal til for å trives hos oss :

  • Bachelor innen helse eller pedagogikk.

  • God erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker med autismespekterforstyrrelse.

  • God relasjonskompetanse og evne til å skape trygghet og tillit.

  • Erfaring fra målrettet miljøarbeid, gjerne med PAS som rammeverk.

  • Evne til å forebygge stress og eskalering gjennom fleksibilitet og forutsigbarhet.

  • Evne til å ivareta beboers rett til selvbestemmelse og medvirkning, samtidig som nødvendig omsorg og trygghet sikres.

  • Du må ha gyldig førerkort klasse B.

Hos oss blir du en del av et faglig sterkt miljø og en bærebjelke i samfunnet vårt. Vi har et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø preget av glede, med nært og stedlig lederskap. Du vil få mulighet til personlig utvikling, påvirkning av egen hverdag og interne karrieremuligheter i et av Norges største private velferdsselskaper. Vi tilbyr selvfølgelig også gode lønnsbetingelser, inkludert vernepleier/sykepleier tillegg, samt pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

title: Er du Helsefagarbeider og har lyst på en spennende og meningsfylt jobb på natt?
description:
Jeg er en 20 år gammel gutt som sitter i rullestol og trenger hjelp til det meste i hverdagen. Jeg søker en helsefagarbeider som kan bidra til at jeg kan leve et aktivt og mer selvstendig liv.


Hos meg vil det alltid være 2:1 på jobb og nødvendige hjelpemidler er tilgjengelig. I løpet av natten vil jeg ha behov for hjelp til stillingsendring og forflytting. Det er også behov for medisinhåndtering og det vil bli pålagt at man tar medisinkurs.


Det er viktig for kroppen min at jeg holder meg i aktivitet gjennom litt uttøying og trening, mine treningsrutiner vil du få opplæring i. Jeg øver på å kommunisere via øynene mine, og rullestolen (som er mine ben) er alltid med meg. Dette er aktuelt hvis du tar ekstravakter på dag/ettermiddag.


Jeg er glad i musikk og drar på kino av og til. Jeg holder til i Langesund og har egen leilighet i huset til familien min. Mamma er arbeidsleder i ordningen, så du vil få god opplæring av henne og av assistentene i Prima Assistanse.

Av og til drar jeg på turer/ferier innenlands og utenlands og trenger da også assistenter med meg. Reiser dekkes selvfølgelig for assistenter. Jeg er i USA en gang i året for opptrening og det er viktig med god oppfølging av treningsrutiner etter denne turen.


Jeg søker etter en Helsefagarbeider i fast nattstilling på 60%, turnus med hver 4. helg.


Ved skoleferier (høst-, jul-, vinter-, påske- og sommerferie) er det et stort behov for ekstravakter.

Ønskelig om du også kan være tilkalling ved ferie og sykdom for mine andre assistenter.


Du må ha kompetanse som Helsefagarbeider eller være sykepleier-/vernepleier-student.


Helsefagarbeidere og sykepleie/vernepleie studenter vil bli lønnet etter gjeldende tariff som Helsefagarbeider.


Fint hvis du er:

·       Initiativrik

·       God på relasjoner

·       Pålitelig

·       Fleksibel

·       Trygg på deg selv

Jeg ønsker meg stødige assistenter som ser muligheter og ikke begrensninger.


Arbeidsoppgaver hos meg vil være å bistå med personlig hygiene, gi medisiner, bistå med å snu meg på natt, lage og pakke ned mat og finne frem klær til neste dag. Må ha kontinuerlig tilsyn i løpet av hele natten.


Jeg kan tilby deg:

·       Godt arbeidsmiljø

·       Varierte arbeidsdager

·       Medisinkurs

·       God opplæring og oppfølging av arbeidsleder og Prima Assistanse

·       Lønn etter gjeldende tariff som Helsefagarbeider

·       Sosiale sammenkomster i form av julebord og sommerfest


Om dette høres spennende ut, ønsker jeg å høre ifra akkurat deg!


Søknader vurderes fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

title: Machine Operator / Production Worker with Operational Responsibility
description:
The position is open to EU/EEA citizens and other applicants with a valid work permit in Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

CC Tekstilservice AS is looking for a machine operator / production worker with operational responsibility for our production facility in Sande.

We are looking for someone who wants an active and varied workday and enjoys combining practical work with responsibility for workflow, quality and completion.

You will become an important part of the team that ensures clothing and other textiles are processed correctly and delivered to our customers on time and to the right quality standard.

This is an operational role with responsibility. You will work actively in production yourself while, after training, taking responsibility for parts of the production flow and being expected to take ownership of your own area of responsibility.

The position is well suited to someone with a strong work capacity, flexibility and a willingness to take responsibility.

You do not necessarily need previous experience in production or textile care. What matters most is that you are willing to learn, work efficiently and contribute positively to the team.

Who is the position suitable for?

We are looking for a positive and reliable employee who likes getting things done and is comfortable taking responsibility.

You take responsibility for your own tasks, follow them through to completion and actively contribute to a smooth production flow.

You are practical, work in a structured and accurate way, and can maintain a good pace without compromising on quality.

We are looking for someone who:

· has a strong work capacity and enjoys an active workday

· is flexible and contributes where needed

· takes responsibility and ownership of their own tasks

· works in a structured and efficient manner

· is accurate and quality-conscious

· is solution-oriented and takes initiative

· works well with others

· can handle a fast pace and varying workloads

· wants to learn and develop

· can communicate in a Scandinavian language or English and understand procedures and safety requirements

Experience from production, textile care or machine operation is an advantage, but not a requirement.

The right attitude, work ethic, sense of responsibility and ability to learn are highly valued by us.

Arbeidsoppgaver

As a machine operator / production worker, you will work hands-on and operationally in production.

The role includes operating production equipment, processing textiles and taking responsibility for parts of the daily production flow.

The main focus is the treatment of clothing and garments, while you will also handle other types of textiles.

After training, you will be responsible for part of the production flow and follow established procedures for quality, efficiency and smooth operations.

This means that you will not only carry out your own tasks, but also help ensure good workflow, correct prioritisation and that work within your area of responsibility is completed on time and to the required quality.

When needed, you will also assist with ironing and pressing clothing and textiles, as well as packing and preparing finished products.

The workday is active and physical, with varied tasks and a pace that is adapted to the production flow and the day's workload.

During busy periods, it is important that you are flexible, solution-oriented and willing to help where the need is greatest so that production runs smoothly and deliveries are completed on time.

Key responsibilities

· Take responsibility for parts of the daily production flow

· Contribute to planning, prioritising and following up production

· Operate production equipment, including dry-cleaning machines and washing machines

· Work with the treatment of clothing, garments and other textiles

· Monitor quality throughout the production process

· Ensure that tasks within your area of responsibility are completed on time and to the required quality

· Contribute to good workflow and efficient production

· Follow procedures for machinery, operations, order and quality

· Carry out basic maintenance of production equipment

· Help the department achieve its production targets

· When needed, assist with ironing, pressing, packing and preparing finished products

Vi tilbyr

Training and development opportunities:

You will receive thorough training in:

· machinery and production equipment

· washing and dry cleaning

· textile care

· stain treatment and spotting

· finishing

· quality assurance

· production flow and internal procedures

Our goal is for you, after training, to take ownership of your own area of responsibility and actively contribute to production that is efficient, well structured and delivers the required quality.

For the right person, there are also good opportunities for further professional development, including the possibility of working towards a Norwegian trade certificate (fagbrev) in textile cleaning.

We offer:

· A permanent full-time position in a stable and growing company

· An active and varied workday with responsibility

· Thorough training and good follow-up

· Well-organised working conditions

· A positive and inclusive working environment with friendly colleagues

· Opportunities for professional and personal development

· The possibility of working towards a trade certificate in textile cleaning for the right person

· Competitive terms by agreement

· Possibility of accommodation / a room by further agreement

Om arbeidsgiveren:

About CC Tekstilservice AS

CC Tekstilservice AS is a leading provider of textile services in Vestfold. We provide textile services to small and large customers in sectors including healthcare, hotels, industry and commercial businesses.

The company has 30 employees and annual turnover of approximately NOK 30 million. Our customers are located from Oslo to Skien and choose us because we deliver quality, reliability and strong professional expertise.

CC Tekstilservice AS is Eco-Lighthouse (Miljøfyrtårn) certified and works actively with environmental responsibility, quality and sustainability. We use, among other things, Nordic Swan Ecolabel products and continuously work to reduce the environmental impact of our production.

In addition, we are self-sufficient in electricity through solar panels and a battery solution.

Sande is centrally located in Vestfold, approximately 45 minutes from Oslo.

Read more about us at: www.cctekstil.no

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Algal Microbiome Engineering
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

At the Norwegian College of Fishery Science, Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, there is a vacant position as a postdoctoral researcher affiliated with the Microalgae & Microbiomes Research Group. The position is for a fixed term of 3 years. It is a prerequisite that the applicant can carry out the project over the full course of the employment period. No person may hold more than one fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the same institution.

The postdoctoral project focuses on programmable marine microbiomes and mechanistic interactions within the diatom phycosphere, with particular emphasis on synthetic biology, microbial ecology, and molecular interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacteria. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of experimental model systems for studying metabolite exchange, microbial community interactions, and engineered microbial consortia in marine environments.

The position is affiliated with ongoing research activities in marine microbiology, synthetic biology, and systems biology at UiT. The research combines microbiology, molecular biology, microbial cultivation, genome-informed molecular ecology, synthetic biology, and multi-omics approaches to better understand and engineer marine microbial ecosystems relevant to carbon cycling and marine biotechnology.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will have the opportunity to advance your scientific career and further qualify for academic positions. If you do not already have the educational competence that meets the requirements for an Associate Professor position in Norway, UiT will arrange such competence during the employment period.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The project/position's field of research

The postdoctoral researcher will develop and apply experimental approaches for studying mechanistic interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacterial communities within the diatom phycosphere. The project will focus on the development of programmable and experimentally tractable microbial model systems using synthetic biology, microbial cultivation, and molecular biology approaches.

The successful candidate will work with cultivation and engineering of marine bacteria and microalgae, construction of synthetic microbial consortia, and investigation of microbial metabolite exchange relevant to nutrient cycling and carbon fixation in marine ecosystems. The project may also involve transcriptomics, genomics, metabolomics, and bioinformatics analyses to investigate molecular interactions between diatoms and associated microorganisms.

The position is part of a broader research program focused on programmable marine microbiomes, marine microbial ecology, and biotechnology applications relevant to climate resilience, sustainable aquaculture, and marine carbon cycling. The postdoctoral researcher will work in an interdisciplinary and international research environment and is expected to contribute actively to scientific publications, collaborative research activities, and external funding development.

You must submit a project proposal (max 2 pages) that describes how you scientifically can contribute to designing diatom phycosphere communities through the uses of engineered genetic circuits or other synthetic biology tools. The proposal should include your view on the state-of-the-art and opportunities for achievable but ground-breaking science with regards to engineering microbial consortia and non-traditional synthetic biology hosts. The proposal must include a progress plan.


Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Group Leader Hans Christopher Bernstein:

  • email: hans.c.bernstein@uit.no 

 or the Head of Department Bjørn Petter Finstad: 

  • email: bjornpetter.finstad@uit.no 

Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • A Norwegian doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign doctoral degree recognized as equivalent to a Norwegian PhD in microbiology, molecular biology, biotechnology, synthetic biology, marine biology, microbial ecology, systems biology, chemical engineering, bioengineering, or another relevant discipline. If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.
  • Excellent written and oral English language skills. Nordic applicants can document their capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.
  • Documented experience in experimental microbiology, molecular biology, and scientific publishing, including publication of research in peer reviewed international journals. Experience in one or more of the following areas is required:
    • synthetic biology
    • microbial cultivation
    • marine microbiology or marine microbial ecology
    • microalgae research
    • molecular cloning and genetic engineering
    • microbial ecology
    • microbial co-cultivation systems

Desired qualifications: 

  • Experience working with non-model microorganisms and/or developing molecular tools for environmental microorganisms is considered particularly advantageous.
  • Experience with one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
    • microbial genomics, transcriptomics, or metagenomics
    • bioinformatics and analysis of omics datasets
    • metabolomics or analytical chemistry
    • microbial community analysis
    • programming/scripting in R, Python, or similar languages
    • systems biology or computational biology
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language or willingness to learn Norwegian is considered an advantage.

The successful candidate must be able to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team. Emphasis will also be placed on motivation, potential for research, scientific creativity, organizational skills, communication abilities, and personal suitability for the position.

In the assessment the main emphasis will be attached to the submitted works and the project proposal for the qualifying work. Emphasis shall also be attached to experience from popularization/dissemination and academic policy and administrative activity.

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Inclusion and diversity  

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.  

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics. 


We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility 


Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter
  • Project proposal (max 2 pages)
  • CV
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • Documentation of educational competence, if available
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important
  • The academic works (published or not) you wish us to take into consideration in the assessment

If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 650'-760' (in a 100% position). (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.) A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

UiT wishes to promote gender equality. If two or more applicants are found to be equally qualified, the university will rank applicants from the underrepresented gender ahead of others.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

title: Hyggelig dame søker fast BPA-assistent 9 timer i uken, nær Oslo!
description:
Hvem er jeg?

Jeg er en kvinne på 38 år som bor i Nittedal (Gjelleråsen, rett ved oslogrensa) sammen med mine to barn. Vi har gode kollektivforbindelser til både Oslo og Romerike.

Jeg lever med utmattelsessykdommen ME og bruker til tider rullestol utendørs/ved aktiviteter. Brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) er min måte å organisere praktisk og personlig bistand på. Målet med ordningen er å gi meg avlastning og frigjøre krefter, slik at jeg kan være til stede for familien min og leve et mer selvstendig liv. Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere ut fra min dagsform.

Hvem søker jeg?

Jeg søker en ny fast assistent i en 9-timers stilling per uke, med gode muligheter for ekstra timer ved behov, sykdom og ferieavvikling.

Ønsker du en meningsfull jobb hvor du kan bidra til å gjøre en reell, positiv forskjell i hverdagen til en familie? Jeg ser etter deg som er presis, pliktoppfyllende, selvgående og fleksibel. Personlig egnethet og gode samarbeidsevner vektlegges høyt.

Kvinner oppfordres til å søke.

Hva skal du gjøre?

  • Matlaging og ernæring: Planlegge, tilberede og servere måltider, opprydning etter mat.

  • Barn og logistikk: Bistå med oppfølging og kjøring/henting til barnas fritidsaktiviteter og avtaler.

  • Skjerming og tilrettelegging: Bidra til ro og tilrettelegge for energiøkonomisering i hverdagen.

  • Husarbeid og ærender: Rengjøring, klesvask, handling og forefallende praktisk arbeid i hjemmet.

  • Bistand ut av huset: Følge til avtaler (som legetimer, turer og ærender), hvor rullestol kan bli benyttet utendørs.

Hva kreves av deg?

  • Førerkort klasse B er et krav. Det er en fordel om du disponerer egen bil og er en trygg sjåfør.

  • Gode norskkunnskaper (minimum nivå B1, både skriftlig og muntlig).

  • God fysisk form (evne til å håndtere/løfte rullestol inn og ut av bil og dytte rullestol i utendørs terreng).

  • Forståelse for skjermingsbehov: Du må ha evne til å være en god «usynlig hjelper» som respekterer ro og tilpasser deg skiftende dagsform.

  • Erfaring med barn: Du må være glad i barn og ha evne til å møte barn som krever god forutsigbarhet og trygghet.

  • Godkjent politiattest (vandel) må fremvises før oppstart.

Om stillingen

Stillingstype: Fast ansettelse

Stillingsstørrelse: 9 timer per uke (med gode muligheter for ekstravakter)

Arbeidstid: Etter nærmere avtale (dag/kveld/helg tilpasses etter behov)

Arbeidssted: Nittedal (Hagan)


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

title: Sykepleiere til hjemmesykepleien
description:
Er du interesert i varierte sykepleieroppgaver og trives med delvis høyt arbeidstempo og innholdsrike arbeidsdager med gode kolleger? Da bør du søke jobb hos oss i hjemmesykepleien.

Opplysninger om enheten

Hjemmesykepleien gir tjenester som pleie, omsorg, behandling og praktisk bistand til personer som bor i egne hjem. Tjenesten skal aktivt jobbe for at personer kan bo og leve mest mulig selvstendig i egne hjem.

Opplysninger om stillingen

Vi har ledig en 100% fast stilling i for tiden 3- delt turnus og et vikariat i 100% i for tiden 2- delt turnus.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Sykepleier leder utøvelsen av sykepleiefaget på vakt
  • Sykepleier har direkte delegert legemiddelansvar og iverksetter ordinasjon fra lege
  • Sykepleier sikrer kontinuitet i pleien gjennom fullstendig rapportering og dokumentasjon
  • Sykepleieren deltar i og arbeider med fagutvikling

Kvalifikasjoner
Faglige:

  • Autorisert sykepleier
  • Førekort klasse B
  • Må beherske norsk muntlig og skriftlig godt

 Vi tilbyr

  • Dekning av flytteutgifter i h.h.t reglement
  • God pensjonsordning og forsikringsordning
  • Gjennom tiltaksordningen: Gratis barnehage fra 01.08.2023 og nedskrivning av studielån, inntil 60.000 kr pr. år.
  • Dersom noen utenfor byen ønsker å søke på stillingen, er det mulighet for å tilby hybel på hybelhuset. Kommunen kan tilby nyansatte og/eller pendlere innenfor prioriterte kompetansegrupper, som følge av rekrutteringsutfordringer, en hybel eller tilsvarende bolig i inntil 2 år, så fremt det er ledig. Tilbudet om bolig er et skattepliktig gode, og den ansatte må derfor betale skatt etter gjeldende regler. For mer informasjon ta kontakt.
  • Sjekk ellers ut hva Vadsø har å by på: www.vds.no og  https://www.visbrosjyre.no/Vadso_kommune/WebView/

Visste du at denne stillingen gir deg fordeler som lavere skatt og økonomiske insentiver gjennom innsatssone-ordningen?
Bruk innsatskalkulatoren for å beregne hvor mye du kan spare, og les mer om innsatssonen her.

Vadsø kommune ønsker ikke å bli kontaktet av annonseselgere.

Lønns- og tilsettingsvilkår
Lønn i h.h.t avtale. Medlemskap i pensjonskasse. Vilkår for stillingen følger lover og avtaler som gjelder til enhver tid.

Ved tilsetting må politiattest og helseattest for tuberkulose og MRSA fremlegges, jf. Lov om kommunale helse- og
omsorgstjenester § 5-4 og Tuberkuloseforskriften. Merknader på politiattest kan medføre endringer i tilbud om stilling.


Søknad sendes
I søknaden oppgis minimum to referanser.

Søknad sendes inn via Easycruit, lenke ligger i utlysningen. Vitnemål og attester kan lastes opp, evt medbringes til eventuelt intervju. Hvis du kommer til intervju tar du med deg godkjente vitnemål.

Vadsø kommune gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkere kan bli gjort offentlig selv om søkeren har anmodet
om ikke å bli ført opp på den offentlige søkerlisten. Dette følger av Offentlighetsloven.

Kontaktperson

Anniken Pleym, Virksomhetsleder, tlf: 789 42585, mobil: 92099272, anniken.pleym@vadso.kommune.no

 


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vadsø er en kommune med både hjerterom og handlingsrom. Her får du spektakulær natur rett utenfor døra, og et levende lokalsamfunn med kaféer, konserter, festivaler, skoler og barnehager av høy kvalitet. title: Machine Operator - Vestfold (Norvège) M/W/X
description:
Do you want a practical and active job in a growing company?

CC Tekstilservice AS is looking for a machine operator / production worker with operational responsibility for our production facility in Sande.

We are looking for someone who wants an active and varied workday and enjoys combining practical work with responsibility for workflow, quality and completion.

You will become an important part of the team that ensures clothing and other textiles are processed correctly and delivered to our customers on time and to the right quality standard.

This is an operational role with responsibility. You will work actively in production yourself while, after training, taking responsibility for parts of the production flow and being expected to take ownership of your own area of responsibility.

The position is well suited to someone with a strong work capacity, flexibility and a willingness to take responsibility.

You do not necessarily need previous experience in production or textile care. What matters most is that you are willing to learn, work efficiently and contribute positively to the team.

As a machine operator / production worker, you will work hands-on and operationally in production. The role includes operating production equipment, processing textiles and taking responsibility for parts of the daily production flow. The main focus is the treatment of clothing and garments, while you will also handle other types of textiles. After training, you will be responsible for part of the production flow and follow established procedures for quality, efficiency and smooth operations. This means that you will not only carry out your own tasks, but also help ensure good workflow, correct prioritisation and that work within your area of responsibility is completed on time and to the required quality. When needed, you will also assist with ironing and pressing clothing and textiles, as well as packing and preparing finished products. The workday is active and physical, with varied tasks and a pace that is adapted to the production flow and the day's workload. During busy periods, it is important that you are flexible, solution-oriented and willing to help where the need is greatest so that production runs smoothly and deliveries are completed on time.

Who is the position suitable for?

We are looking for a positive and reliable employee who likes getting things done and is comfortable taking responsibility. You take responsibility for your own tasks, follow them through to completion and actively contribute to a smooth production flow. 

We are looking for someone who:

  • has a strong work capacity and enjoys an active workday
  • is flexible and contributes where needed
  • takes responsibility and ownership of their own tasks
  • works in a structured and efficient manner
  • is accurate and quality-conscious
  • is solution-oriented and takes initiative
  • works well with others
  • can handle a fast pace and varying workloads
  • wants to learn and develop
  • can communicate in a Scandinavian language or English and understand procedures and safety requirements

Experience from production, textile care or machine operation is an advantage, but not a requirement. The right attitude, work ethic, sense of responsibility and ability to learn are highly valued by us.

Key responsibilities

  • Take responsibility for parts of the daily production flow
  • Contribute to planning, prioritising and following up production
  • Operate production equipment, including dry-cleaning machines and washing machines
  • Work with the treatment of clothing, garments and other textiles
  • Monitor quality throughout the production process
  • Ensure that tasks within your area of responsibility are completed on time and to the required quality
  • Contribute to good workflow and efficient production
  • Follow procedures for machinery, operations, order and quality
  • Carry out basic maintenance of production equipment
  • Help the department achieve its production targets
  • When needed, assist with ironing, pressing, packing and preparing finished products

Training and development opportunities

You will receive thorough training in:

  • machinery and production equipment
  • washing and dry cleaning
  • textile care
  • stain treatment and spotting
  • finishing
  • quality assurance
  • production flow and internal procedures

Our goal is for you, after training, to take ownership of your own area of responsibility and actively contribute to production that is efficient, well structured and delivers the required quality. For the right person, there are also good opportunities for further professional development, including the possibility of working towards a Norwegian trade certificate (fagbrev) in textile cleaning.

Permanent, full-time position in a stable and growing company

- Thorough training and orderly working conditions

- A good and inclusive working environment with friendly colleagues

- Opportunities for professional and personal development for the right person

- Competitive terms by agreement

- Possibility of housing/accommodation by further agreement

description:
Project Manager / Delivery Assurance for SAP and Service Now (f/m/d)

Full or part time

At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.

We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.

**Make this the place where you grow

**Location: **Germany, Poland, Bulgaria or Romania

What makes us special:

We have a holistic view of the individual needs of our employees. Here (https://nttdata-solutions.com/de/karriere/benefits/)  you can find a detailed overview of our wide variety of benefits during different life phases.

■ Flexible working hours and locations: workation, mobile working, part-time models, sabbaticals, etc.

■ Your further development by plan: topic-specific induction, targeted career development based on career models, programs and your own academy

■ Family first: e.g. daycare allowance, paid maternity leave and paternity network

■ SAP Platinum Partnership: strong SAP partnership, large knowledge network, and SAP Learning Hub and certification opportunities.

■ We take care: e.g. 25% subsidy for company pension plan, company health management and cooperation with fitness providers

■ We help you get from A to B: company car (depending on your role), discount on public transport and bicycle leasing via JobRad®.

Do you love challenges?

As Project / Delivery Assurance Manager for SAP and ServiceNow Projects and Managed Services, you will be responsible for:

■ Conducting risk and quality assessments for new and existing large customer engagements, ensuring SAP and ServiceNow-specific risks are addressed.

■ Providing feedback on the Deal Governance process to ensure that new projects and services meet agreed standards and quality expectations.

■ Supporting Red/Amber projects by developing and executing "Back to Green" action plans, including internal management reporting.

■ Managing customer escalations: leading top management customer escalations, supporting executive management in the de-escalation process, addressing root causes, and restoring customer confidence.

■ Defining the necessary quality checks for SAP and ServiceNow projects and services to ensure quality, speed and profitability

Convince us with your potential!

■ Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field

Several years of work experience in Delivery Assurance, Project and/or Services Management proves your:

■ Expertise in SAP and ServiceNow within complex enterprise environments

■ Delivery assurance skills, supported by certification (e.g. Six Sigma)

■ Strong project/service management and leadership abilities

■ Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach

■ Excellent communication and collaboration skills with technical and business stakeholders

■ Commitment to continuous improvement, attention to detail, and adaptability under pressure

■ Knowledge of IT standards and regulations (ISO 9001, CMMI, GDPR)

■ Proficiency in written and spoken English and German

Do you have questions?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents stating your earliest start date.

title: Front Office Supervisor  (Empfangschef/in (Hotel))
description:
Front Office Supervisor

Opis firmy

Tworzymy wyjątkowe miejsce dla naszych Gości dzięki wspólnej pasji do nowoczesnego designu i wysokiej jakości obsługi.

Już ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast.

Dołącz do naszego zespołu w Gdańsku!

Odkryj możliwości pracy w miejscu, gdzie liczy się pasja, zaangażowanie i chęć rozwoju!

Opis oferty pracy

Twoim priorytetem będzie troska o dobre samopoczucie Gości i Pracowników!

Twoje obowiązki będą obejmować również:

- Meldowanie Gości, sprawdzanie listy przyjazdów oraz innych raportów
- Zapewnienie profesjonalnej, najwyższej jakości obsługi
- Monitorowanie oraz reagowanie na opinie Gości

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

Czy posiadasz wyjątkową osobowość oraz doskonałe umiejętności z zakresu gościnności?

Jeśli tak, to idealnie będziesz pasować na to stanowisko! Nasze dodatkowe wymagania:

- Doświadczenie zawodowe w branży hotelarskiej
- Doskonałe wyczucie jakości i obsługi
- Otwartość, komunikatywność oraz bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (w mowie i piśmie)
- Umiejętność pracy w zespole i gotowość do udzielania pomocy we wszystkich działach – wyniki osiąga się dzięki współpracy!
- Praca w godzinach porannych, popołudniowych i/lub nocnych

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.

- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

description:
Zakres obowiązków: OGÓLNY ZAKRES PODSTAWOWYCH OBOWIĄZKÓW:
1. Kierowanie  zespołem do spraw realizacji zadań z zakresu pomocy społecznej, organizowanie pracy podległych pracowników socjalnych oraz nadzór i kontrola nad rzetelnością, jakością i zgodnością ze stanem faktycznym i prawnym sporządzanych przez nich dokumentów.
2. Realizowanie innych zadań z zakresu pomocy społecznej wynikających z potrzeb gminy, w tym tworzenia i realizacja programów rządowych pomocy społecznej mających na celu ochronę i poprawę życia osób, rodzin i grup społecznych.
3. Prowadzenie analizy wykorzystania środków przychodzących z budżetu i innych będących w dyspozycji jednostki.
4. Kontrolowanie prawidłowości i rzetelności prowadzonych przez pracownika socjalnego rodzinnych wywiadów środowiskowych oraz ich zatwierdzanie.
5. Organizowanie udzielania świadczeń pomocy społecznej - pieniężnej, w naturze i usługach.
6. Współdziałanie w sprawach świadczeń pomocy społecznej z działem księgowości.
7. Współpraca przy opracowywaniu planów ośrodka z zakresu pomocy społecznej.
8. Nadzór nad merytorycznym i terminowym przygotowywaniem dokumentów, planowania i sprawozdawczości.
WARUNKI PRACY:
1. Pełny wymiar czasu pracy - 1 etat.
2. Przewidywany termin rozpoczęcia pracy po rozstrzygnięciu naboru.
3. Obiekt Centrum Usług Społecznych w Mikołowie przy ul. Kolejowej 2 jest przystosowany dla osób niepełnosprawnych ruchowo.
4. Praca przy monitorze ekranowym, praca w terenie.
5. Praca obarczona odpowiedzialnością, związana z samodzielnym organizowaniem pracy komórki organizacyjnej centrum.

oraz potrzeb mieszkańców miasta w zakresie pomocy i wsparcia społecznego, w tym przygotowywanie danych, informacji i materiałów oraz formułowanie wniosków.

i informacji niezbędnych do ich przygotowania oraz przekazywanie wymaganych dokumentów zgodnie z obowiązującymi procedurami.
8. Współpraca przy opracowywaniu, realizacji i monitorowaniu programów na rzecz mieszkańców miasta w zakresie pomocy społecznej oraz zadań wynikających z programów rządowych i innych przepisów prawa, w tym przygotowywanie materiał

title: Wychowawca/Wychowawczyni w placówce Wsparcia Dziennego dla dzieci i młodzieży
description:
Zakres obowiązków: Prowadzenie zajęć z grupą. Sprawowanie opieki nad procesem wychowania dzieci w Placówce. Prowadzenie dokumentacji dziecka- opracowywanie przy udziale dziecka indywidualnego planu pracy w porozumieniu z psychopedagogiem, wychowawcą, pracownikiem socjalnym, a także innymi specjalistami. Indywidualny plan pracy uwzględnia działania krótkoterminowe, długoterminowe, jest modyfikowany w zależności od zmieniającej się sytuacji dziecka, nie rzadziej niż co pół roku. description:

3) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w poprawie ich sytuacji życiowej, w tym w zdobywaniu umiejętności prawidłowego prowadzenia gospodarstwa domowego;

6) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w rozwiązywaniu problemów wychowawczych               z dziećmi;

8) motywowanie członków rodzin do podnoszenia kwalifikacji zawodowych;
9) udzielanie pomocy w poszukiwaniu, podejmowaniu i utrzymywaniu pracy zarobkowej;

12) podejmowanie działań interwencyjnych i zaradczych w sytuacji zagrożenia bezpieczeństwa dzieci i rodzin;
13) prowadzenie dokumentacji dotyczącej pracy z rodziną;
14) dokonywanie okresowej oceny sytuacji rodziny, nie rzadziej niż co pół roku;
15) monitorowanie funkcjonowania rodziny po zakończeniu pracy z rodziną;
16) sporządzanie, na wniosek sądu, opinii o rodzinie i jej członkach;
17) współpraca z jednostkami administracji rządowej i samorządowej, właściwymi organizacjami pozarządowymi oraz innymi podmiotami i osobami specjalizującymi się w działaniach na rzecz dziecka i rodziny;
18) współpraca z zespołem interdyscyplinarnym lub grupą roboczą lub innymi podmiotami, których pomoc przy wykonywaniu zadań uzna za niezbędną;
19) koor

title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent)Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

title: TÉCNICO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL
description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

Terá como principais responsabilidades: realizar consultas de nutrição e elaborar planos alimentares personalizados e sustentáveis, ajustados aos objetivos de cada cliente; acompanhar a evolução dos sócios, garantindo a sua motivação contínua; trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipa técnica para promover uma abordagem integrada ao bem-estar; promover os serviços de nutrição junto de sócios e potenciais clientes; e dinamizar ações de sensibilização, workshops e campanhas focadas na alimentação saudável.Perfil Pretendido:Licenciatura em Ciências da Nutrição / Dietética e inscrição válida na Ordem dos Nutricionistas;Forte capacidade de comunicação, empatia e facilidade no contacto com o público;Orientação para o cliente, alcance de resultados e promoção da saúde;Elevada capacidade de organização, autonomia e gestão de prioridades;Espírito de iniciativa, proatividade e foco na melhoria contínua;Disponibilidade de horários para horário completo e facilidade de adaptação a ambientes dinâmicos de ginásio.Condições Oferecidas:Contrato de trabalho em regime de Full-Time;Integração numa equipa jovem, dinâmica e ambiciosa;Oportunidade de crescimento profissional e pessoal;Formação contínua e desenvolvimento de carreira na área da nutrição e do fitness;Remuneração compatível com a função e com a experiência demonstrada.Se acreditas que uma alimentação equilibrada transforma vidas e que o acompanhamento nutricional é essencial para o sucesso dos clientes, junta-te à nossa equipa!

title: TÉCNICOS E ASSISTENTES FARMACÊUTICOS
description:
COLABORADOR(A) PARA INTEGRAR A EQUIPA DA FARMÁCIA, PREFERENCIALMENTE FARMACÊUTICO(A) OU TÉCNICO(A) DE FARMÁCIA. NO ENTANTO, ESTAMOS TAMBÉM RECETIVOS À INTEGRAÇÃO DE ESTUDANTES DA ÁREA DAS CIÊNCIAS FARMACÊUTICAS/FARMÁCIA QUE TENHAM INTERESSE EM CONCILIAR OS ESTUDOS COM UMA EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL EM FARMÁCIA COMUNITÁRIA.
A VAGA DESTINA-SE A REFORÇAR A EQUIPA DURANTE UMA LICENÇA DE MATERNIDADE, COM INÍCIO PREVISTO ENTRE AGOSTO E SETEMBRO DE 2026, EM REGIME DE PART-TIME (CERCA DE 20 A 25 HORAS SEMANAIS). TRATA-SE DE UMA FARMÁCIA COMUNITÁRIA EM VILA NOVA DE POIARES, A APROXIMADAMENTE 30 MINUTOS DE COIMBRA, INSERIDA NUM CONTEXTO RURAL E COM UMA FORTE LIGAÇÃO À COMUNIDADE.
PROCURAMOS UMA PESSOA RESPONSÁVEL, AUTÓNOMA, COM BOA CAPACIDADE DE COMUNICAÇÃO E INTERESSE PELA ÁREA DA FARMÁCIA COMUNITÁRIA. A INTEGRAÇÃO SERÁ FEITA NUMA EQUIPA ESTÁVEL, ATUALMENTE COMPOSTA POR TRÊS FARMACÊUTICOS E UM TÉCNICO AUXILIAR DE FARMÁCIA.

description:
Pretende-se recrutar um/a Jardineiro/a para integrar a equipa da Yucca Paisagismo, empresa dedicada à criação, implementação e manutenção de espaços verdes e jardins, com foco na qualidade, estética e cuidado dos espaços exteriores.

O/a profissional deverá ter experiência ou conhecimentos na área de jardinagem e manutenção de espaços verdes, demonstrando gosto pelo trabalho ao ar livre, sentido de responsabilidade, atenção ao detalhe e capacidade de trabalhar de forma autónoma e em equipa.

As principais funções incluem a manutenção e tratamento de jardins, nomeadamente poda de árvores, arbustos e plantas, corte e manutenção de relvados, controlo de infestantes, adubação e tratamentos fitossanitários, rega e manutenção de sistemas de rega, plantação e transplante de espécies, limpeza e organização dos espaços exteriores e apoio na implementação de novos jardins e projetos de paisagismo.

Procura-se uma pessoa responsável, assídua, organizada, dinâmica e cuidadosa, com capacidade para seguir orientações técnicas e manter elevados padrões de qualidade no trabalho realizado. Valoriza-se experiência com diferentes espécies vegetais, conhecimentos de identificação e necessidades das plantas e experiência na utilização e manutenção de ferramentas e equipamentos de jardinagem.

Será valorizada a experiência profissional anterior na área, bem como carta de condução e facilidade de deslocação entre diferentes locais de trabalho. A capacidade de trabalhar em equipa, o bom relacionamento interpessoal e uma atitude proativa serão igualmente considerados fatores importantes.

title: Italian-Speaking Technical Support Specialist (m,f) : Drone (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Start: 03.08. or 01.09.26

We are partnering with a global technology company to recruit Italian-speaking Technical Support Specialists for a new project based in Italy.

In this role, you will provide professional technical assistance and customer support to users of cutting-edge camera drones. You will guide customers through troubleshooting, product usage, and problem resolution while ensuring an excellent overall experience. This is a great opportunity to work in a fast-paced, international environment with the latest technology.

Your Role
Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and chat in Italian.
Troubleshoot and resolve product-related issues with camera drones.
Assist customers with setup, functionality, and maintenance guidance.
Educate users on features, firmware updates, and common usage issues.
Log and manage cases accurately in internal systems.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to escalate complex technical problems.
Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction through timely and professional communication.

Your Qualifications
Native or fluent Italian (C1 level)
Basic knowledge of English for internal communication
Previous experience in technical support, IT, or electronics is preferred
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent communication and customer service skills
Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, international environment
Interest or experience in drones, consumer electronics, or related technology is a plus

The Offer
Full-time position with a structured onboarding and paid training
Hybrid working model (office + remote) depending on operational needs
Competitive compensation and benefits package
Career development opportunities within an international tech company
Work in a collaborative, international team and gain exposure to cutting-edge technology

title: Cuisinier (H/F)
description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

title: EIC Supervisor

- relevant technical education in electrical engineering, automation, instrumentation or a related field

- good IT and reporting skills

- fluent English skills


Accommodation and project-related travel can be arranged by CMS as agreed.

title: EIC Supervisor
description:
CMS Construction Management Solutions Oy is looking for an experienced **EIC Supervisor** for our client's industrial project in Northern Slovakia.

As an EIC Supervisor, you will be responsible for supervising and coordinating electrical, instrumentation and control-related activities at site. You will work closely with contractors, other technical disciplines and the project team to support the safe, high-quality and efficient execution of the works.

**Your responsibilities include**

- supervising and coordinating electrical, instrumentation and control-related works at site

- monitoring the progress and quality of installation works

- ensuring that works are carried out in accordance with project requirements, drawings and instructions

- coordinating contractors and other project parties within your area of responsibility

- supporting inspections, testing and commissioning activities

- following up on technical issues, deviations and outstanding works

- supporting the completion and follow-up of required site and quality documentation

- coordinating activities and interfaces with other technical disciplines

- monitoring progress and reporting on site activities

- ensuring safe working practices within your area of responsibility


**We are looking for**

- relevant technical education in electrical engineering, automation, instrumentation or a related field

- previous experience in similar supervisory roles involving electrical, instrumentation and/or control works in industrial projects

- good understanding of industrial installation and site activities within your area of expertise

- ability to read and understand relevant technical drawings and project documentation

- good IT and reporting skills

- fluent English skills


Accommodation and project-related travel can be arranged by CMS as agreed.

**Location:** Northern Slovakia

**Start:** September–October 2026

**Estimated duration:** approximately 6 months

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Správcovia objektov
description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv.
