title: CNC-operatör till avancerad bearbetning
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vill du arbeta med avancerad bearbetning, moderna maskiner och produkter som används över hela världen?

Hos Epiroc i Kalmar får du mer än bara ett jobb vid maskinen. Du får arbeta i en högteknologisk produktionsmiljö där din yrkesskicklighet värdesätts, där kvalitet och säkerhet alltid går först – och där du som erfaren CNC‑operatör verkligen kan göra skillnad.

Allt börjar med människor. Människor som du.

Bli en del av vårt teamVi befinner oss i en tillväxtfas och söker nu skickliga CNC‑operatörer som vill vara med och bygga framtidens produktion tillsammans med oss. Här finns långsiktighet, stabilitet och utvecklingsmöjligheter för dig som vill ta nästa steg – hos ett företag som satsar på framtiden.

Epiroc i Kalmar tillverkar världsledande hydrauliska produkter till gruv‑ och anläggningsindustrin – och nu breddar och vidareutvecklar vi vårt produktutbud. Det innebär investeringar i ny teknik, automation, och nya metoder för bearbetning och värmebehandling. Nyfiken på att bli med på resan? Läs mer om Epiroc i Kalmar här.

Ditt uppdrag Som CNC‑operatör hos oss får du arbeta med komponenter och produkter där kraven på precision, kvalitet och spårbarhet är höga. Det du tillverkar används i krävande miljöer världen över – vilket ställer höga krav, men också ger en tydlig stolthet i arbetet.

Maskinbearbetningen bedrivs i moderna fleroperationsmaskiner och svarvar, och kommer inom kort även att omfatta slipning. I rollen ingår ett helhetsansvar för dina maskiner och arbeten, vilket bland annat innebär:


    Självständig körning och övervakning av CNC‑maskiner
    Planering av det dagliga arbetet och hantering av tillverkningsorder
    Verktygshantering och processnära kvalitetsarbete
    Daglig tillsyn av maskiner, utrustning och arbetsmiljö

Din profilVi söker dig som är noggrann, ansvarstagande och trivs i en miljö där teknik, problemlösning och ständig utveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen. Ditt intresse och engagemang för bearbetning gör att du gärna delar med dig av din erfarenhet, testar nya arbetssätt och bidrar till ett stabilt och effektivt produktionsflöde, alltid med stort fokus på säkerhet och kvalitet.

Vi ser gärna att du har:


    Erfarenhet av arbete som CNC‑operatör, alternativt relevant CNC‑utbildning kombinerad med praktisk erfarenhet
    God datorvana för dokumentation, rapportering och produktionsuppföljning
    Goda kunskaper i svenska, i både tal och skrift

Vill du utvecklas vidare inom skärande bearbetning och samtidigt vara med och forma framtidens produktion med oss? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan.

Placering och arbetstiderDenna tjänst är placerad i Kalmar, Sverige. Arbetet är förlagt till kontinuerligt skiftarbete, vilket innebär att du behöver vara flexibel och trivas med ett rullande schema.

Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.

Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:


    Globala karriärmöjligheter.
    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.
    Samhällsengagemang.
    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.

Ansökan och kontaktinformationDu ansöker på vår karriärsida, genom att ladda upp ditt CV (personligt brev behövs ej) och svara på några korta frågor. Ansökningar granskas löpande och vi uppmuntrar att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast den 30 september 2026.

Har du frågor om tjänsten, välkommen att kontakta oss:

Tekla Brunetto, Rekryteringsspecialist, tekla.brunetto@external.epiroc.com.

Ibro Lindh, Produktionsledare, ibro.lindh@epiroc.com.

Vänligen observera att vi inte kan hantera ansökningar som skickas in via e-post.

Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: IT Lead
description:
Role Summary

As TRATON Financial Services continues to expand its global footprint, the IT organization must evolve alongside the business to ensure technology remains a strategic enabler across all markets. To support this growth, six IT Lead positions will be introduced within the global IT organization, each reporting directly to the Chief Digital & Information Officer (CDIO). One of these roles will be responsible for the Southern Europe region. We are open to candidates located in Sweden, Germany, France, Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Bulgaria and Romania. Please expect app. 20% of international travels.

Acting as IT leader, the IT Lead will provide functional leadership to local market IT teams, driving collaboration, alignment, and the adoption of best practices across the region. The role combines strategy, operations, stakeholder management, governance, cybersecurity, vendor oversight, and transformation delivery. This position will play a key part in identifying synergies, optimizing resources, and ensuring the effective delivery of IT initiatives in support of both regional and global business objectives.



Job Responsibilities

    IT Strategy - Translate global IT strategy into regional execution plans aligned with business goals.
    Business Partnership - Act as the main IT partner for regional and market business leaders, ensuring technology supports growth, efficiency, and risk management.
    Governance - Ensure compliance with global policies, cybersecurity standards, regulatory requirements, and audit expectations.
    Budget & Cost Control - Oversee market IT budgets, cost optimization, forecasting, and investment prioritization.
    Transformation - Lead digitalization, automation, cloud adoption, system modernization, and process improvement initiatives.
    People Leadership – Steer market IT teams, capability development, performance, and succession planning.
    Risk & Security - Support markets in cyber resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, access controls, and data protection.
    Vendor Management – Steer regional technology vendors, outsourcing partners, SLAs, contracts, and escalations.
    Change Management - Drive adoption of new tools, systems, processes, and operating models across the region.

Who you are

    10-15 years of professional experience in a corporate environment, with a strong track record of delivering business and technology outcomes.
    University degree together with fluent English.
    Solid hands-on IT background, with expertise across IT operations, software solutions, and/or data processing environments.
    Recent experience supporting and executing global IT strategies and business transformations within group and/or matrix organization.
    Proven ability to drive change, solve complex challenges, and navigate dynamic business environments with a proactive mindset.
    Strong leadership and people management experience, including at least 3-5 years in a managerial role.
    Experience leading geographically dispersed and remote teams, fostering collaboration and alignment across multiple locations.
    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across business and IT functions.
    Demonstrated capability to identify synergies, promote best practices, and drive standardization across markets and regions.

Traton Financial Services Offers

Our culture is characterised by openness, collaboration, diversity and respect for the individual. We believe that different experiences and perspectives create a stronger workplace and better results. The right mindset, curiosity and willingness to learn are as important to us as previous experience.

We believe great work starts with feeling supported, both professionally and personally. That’s why we offer a broad range of employee benefits designed to promote wellbeing, flexibility, and a healthy work-life balance. Employees can enjoy flexible working hours and a workplace that supports both collaboration and flexibility. With office Hubs in Södertälje and Stockholm, as well as coworking spaces at Sergels Torg and Kungens Kurva, you will have the best preconditions to pick the best workplace for your activities.

We provide a yearly wellness contribution and you can train at our health center Gröndal, and you will access to occupational health services with doctors, nurses, and ergonomists. Mental health is important to us, therefore we also offer confidential staff support services for guidance related to personal challenges.

In addition, employees benefit from pension plans, profit sharing programs, and extra time off or additional pension contributions. We also support family life through enhanced parental benefits and offer additional perks such as employee car leasing. Together, these benefits help create a workplace where you can thrive both at work and in everyday life.



Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your English CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-28. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

title: Audit Data & AI Solutions Engineer
description:
Role Summary

TRATON Financial Services’ Internal Audit department is looking for an Audit Data & AI Solutions Engineer to help build the next generation of audit technology.

Internal Audit is the third line of defense. We look for things others may have missed — the proverbial needle in the haystack. Our role is to assess whether controls designed to prevent mistakes, fraud, inefficiency, and regulatory breaches are actually working in practice.

For several years, we have successfully used source-system data, analytics, and dashboards to make audits more targeted and data-driven. Building on that foundation, we are now expanding into AI-enabled audit technology: automating parts of audit sample testing by drawing evidence-based conclusions from documents in multiple languages, identifying unusual assets or transactions, and building dashboards and applications that help auditors focus on what matters most.

You will be part of a small team within Internal Audit that builds the solutions to make this happen. The work spans hands-on data mapping, source-system analysis, Power BI or HTML dashboards, anomaly detection, machine learning, and agentic AI solutions for audit sample testing and document review.

This creates both opportunities and challenges. We can move quickly, test ideas, and learn through short feedback loops with auditors. At the same time, we do not have large predefined frameworks, methods, or roadmaps. We need people who enjoy building things in complex environments, can operate between data, software, AI, and business processes, and can create solutions that are structured, documented, trustworthy, and sustainable.

Job Responsibilities

As Audit Data & AI Solutions Engineer, you will build and maintain data, analytics, automation, and AI solutions that help Internal Audit assess controls and identify anomalies. That includes:

    Retrieving, mapping, validating, and structuring data from source systems across brands and markets
    Building analytics and algorithms to identify anomalies, control weaknesses, unusual transactions, approval issues, collateral risks, or financial crime indicators
    Developing AI-enabled and agentic solutions for document analysis and audit sample testing, including prompts, skills, tools, agent workflows, evaluation logic, and evidence-based outputs
    Creating Power BI, HTML, or other dashboards that present complex findings in a clear and useful way
    Ensuring that algorithms, prompts, data flows, and assumptions are documented and built in a modular way so they can be reused.

Who you are:

We are looking for a fast learner and hands-on builder who has:

    Strong Python and SQL skills
    Comfort using AI tools and coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar to write, test, debug, and improve code
    Curiosity to understand business processes, controls, audit logic, and what makes an analysis useful in practice
    The ability to turn unclear business problems into working, tested, and maintainable solutions
    Experience building practical technical solutions such as scripts, data tools, dashboards, applications, automations, or analytics workflows
    Strong analytical and debugging skills, including the ability to investigate data quality issues, logic errors, and unexpected results
    A structured approach to documentation, testing, version control, and reusable code
    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

It is an advantage if you have experience with:

    Power BI, data modelling, DAX, Power Query, or code-based Power BI development
    Machine learning, anomaly detection, exception reporting, or process monitoring
    LLM applications, document analysis, agents, RAG, prompt/context engineering, tool use, skills, OCR, JSON, APIs, or workflow applications
    Additional languages, data visualization, financial services, audit, risk, compliance, or controls.

This Is Us

At TRATON Financial Services (TFS) we have started the journey to become the provider of Financial Services to all TRATON brands. Our service includes financing for customers, dealers, and distributors as well as insurance solutions. With a presence in over 65 markets, we are already one of the most global actors in the financial services industry and are rapidly growing. Do you want to be part of this journey?

That’s why we offer a broad range of employee benefits designed to promote wellbeing, flexibility, and a healthy work-life balance. Employees can enjoy flexible working hours and a workplace that supports both collaboration and flexibility. With office Hubs in Södertälje and Stockholm, as well as coworking spaces at Sergels Torg and Kungens Kurva, you will have the best preconditions to pick the best workplace for your activities.

We provide a yearly wellness contribution and you can train at our health centre Gröndal, and you will access to occupational health services with doctors, nurses, and ergonomists. Mental health is important to us, therefore we also offer confidential staff support services for guidance related to personal challenges.

In addition, employees benefit from pension plans, profit sharing programs, and extra time off or additional pension contributions. title: Konsult Strategy&
description:

A career at Strategy& will provide you with the opportunity to work with some of the world’s largest and most complex companies to understand their unique business issues and opportunities in an ever-changing environment. More specifically, we work with leading corporations and Private Equity firms on strategic topics, focused on our core platforms Capabilities-Driven Strategy, Fit for Growth and Deals Strategy. Example assignments with corporate Clients include strategic review, growth strategy, market expansion, profit/margin improvement, and operating model design. For Private Equity firms, we support with commercial due diligence, market study and PortCo value creation strategy and business plan.

What we offer

You will work on the most strategic topics across a wide range of different industries and have the ability to influence your staffing to align with your passion and interests. You will be surrounded with people who will not only challenge you intellectually, but also inspire and guide you, drive your ambition, and care about your personal and professional development.     Pure play strategy consulting work within a wide range of industries
    Part of a top-tier strategy consultancy, both locally and globally
    Access to the resources and capabilities of the global PwC network
    Ability to influence Strategy&’s exciting growth journey

Responsibilities

title: Tenure Track Position at the Department of Accounting, SSE
description:
The Department of Accounting at the Stockholm School of Economics invites applications for a tenure-track position at the Assistant Professor level in accounting (including areas such as financial reporting, auditing, management accounting and control).

Your profile and qualifications

Qualified candidates should hold a doctoral degree and must have completed said requirement before taking up the position. As a candidate, you should have a research background in accounting, with a particular interest in digital resilience and/or risk management. You should also have an interest in conducting research that has practical implications for organizations. The successful candidate is expected to thrive in a research environment that values methodological pluralism and theoretical diversity in the study of accounting phenomena.

The basic requirement is that the candidate is strong both in research and teaching. The ideal candidate is someone with a promising research record as evidenced by publications – or the credible potential to publish – in top tier accounting journals. In addition, applicants should be able to teach various accounting-related topics at the (minimum) undergraduate level.

Conditions

The tenure track period is 6 years, conditional on successful mid-term review after 3 years. Tenure evaluation takes place after a maximum of 6 years, and successful evaluation leads to conversion of the tenure-track position into a tenured Associate Professor position. A tentative starting date for the successful applicant is Spring 2027, but SSE is open to discussing other dates, whether earlier or later. Salaries are set on an individual basis.

To be considered for the position, candidates need to submit:

    A letter of application articulating the candidate´s fit with the position description and profile of the department, including research interests and teaching competence,
    Curriculum vitae,
    Copies of representative research (published articles or working papers)
    Names and contact information of three references.

The application must be received by November 14, 2026. All applications are to be sent in through the SSE recruitment system Varbi.

About the department

The Department of Accounting is a leading accounting department in the Nordics with about 20 faculty and 10 PhD students. Our research covers a broad range of topics related to e.g., auditing, financial accounting and reporting, management accounting & control, and sustainability accounting. Our faculty, many with an international background, regularly publish in leading accounting journals and employ both qualitative and quantitative research methods. More information about our faculty profile and research activities can be found on the SSE Department of Accounting website (https://www.hhs.se/en/research/departments/da/people/).

Our teaching is highly appreciated by both students and executives, and our faculty is engaged in teaching at the Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA levels as well as at SSE Executive Education. We offer a two-year Master Program in Accounting, Valuation and Financial Management, known for its practical relevance and excellent placement of the students. We also have ambitious outreach work navigated through our Accounting and Financial Management Center of Excellence (ACE) which involves corporate partners like Atlas Copco, Deloitte, Elekta, Ericsson, EY, Grant Thornton, Handelsbanken, Investor, KPMG, McKinsey, Nordea, PwC, Ratos, and Skanska.

For further questions

Please direct informal inquiries about the nature of the positions to one of the following:

Professor Lukas Goretzki (lukas.goretzki@hhs.se), Head of Department

Professor Kalle Kraus (kalle.kraus@hhs.se)



For HR related queries: HR Business partner Ellen Falkenström (ellen.falkenstrom@hhs.se)

About the Stockholm School of Economics

The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.

Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.

SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.

SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. - Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und modernen Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, gezielter Jobvermittlung und kontinuierlicher Betreuung, um Ihnen den Einstieg in eine passende Stelle unkompliziert zu gestalten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Wetzikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German  
Travel Requirements: This position will require limited travel (less than 10%) domestic and international travel jpidfb0434cjm jit0729jm jiy26jm

per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine:n

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit System Engineers, Network und Security

title: Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène  à 60%
description:
Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène (H/F/D) à 60%  
Les Usines Métallurgiques de Vallorbe SA (UMV) sont reconnues au niveau international comme le partenaire préféré des professionnels les plus exigeants pour ses outils de précision. Disposant de grandes capacités d’innovation, la société, forte de près de 200 collaborateurs, commercialise ses produits dans plus de 80 pays via un réseau de distribution.  
Dans le cadre d’une création de poste suite au développement de nos activités, nous sommes à la recherche d’un/e  
Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène (H/F/D) à 60%  
Vos missions  
Il ou elle assure une présence terrain régulière et contribue à la mise en œuvre et au suivi opérationnel des mesures de santé, sécurité \& hygiène définies par le Responsable SSH. Il ou elle appuie les équipes de production, de maintenance et d’infrastructure dans l’application quotidienne des règles de sécurité.  
Cette fonction est distincte du rôle de spécialiste MSST reconnu selon l’Ordonnance sur les qualifications des spécialistes de la sécurité au travail, qui reste porté exclusivement par le Responsable SSH.  
Vos activités :  
Réaliser des tournées de sécurité régulières sur le terrain et contrôler l’application de la politique SSH et des points sécurité \& santé (feu, gaz, matériel de sécurité, matériel de secours, EPI),  
Participer à l’élaboration des documents opérationnels de sécurité, en appui du Responsable SSH,  
Travailler en collaboration avec le Responsable SSH à la réduction des risques du site,  
Gérer les équipements de protection individuelle (attribution, contrôle, renouvellement, traçabilité),  
Mettre à jour la documentation relative aux contrôles et aux mesures terrain,  
Remonter les points sécurité au Responsable SSH et participer à l’amélioration des statistiques incidents, presqu’accidents et accidents,  
Analyser les événements terrain, proposer des plans d’actions correctifs et en assurer le suivi,  
Participer aux projets et actions en lien avec le secteur SSH et les différents secteurs de production,  
Participer à l’organisation des exercices d’évacuation pour le personnel,  
Assurer un appui administratif au groupe des Samaritains, en soutien du Responsable SSH,  
Assurer un soutien opérationnel dans le suivi des accès (clés, logiciels de contrôle d’accès),  
Gérer les vêtements de travail, les vestiaires, l’infirmerie et le matériel d’urgence,  
Instruire les collaborateurs aux exigences SSH,  
Planifier et coordonner les formations terrain (quart d’heure sécurité, causeries, exercices pratiques),  
Communiquer au Responsable SSH le suivi des indicateurs et constats terrain,  
Collaborer avec les prestataires externes pour les aspects opérationnels et remonter les informations au Responsable SSH pour la prise de décision.  
Compétences professionnelles et personnelles  
Faire preuve de discernement et de confiance en soi  
Être apte à gérer des situations de conflit  
Être doté d’une capacité d’observation, d’analyse et de synthèse  
Être à l’aise dans les contacts humains et l’expression en public  
Être à l’écoute et avoir la capacité à conserver distance et lucidité  
Force de proposition  
Respecter les valeurs de l’entreprise  
Gestion du stress  
Discrétion.  
Formation base et continue  
Formation de base en sécurité au travail (PERCO STPS ou Assistant de sécurité STPS)  
Expérience de min. 2 à 3 ans, idéalement dans le domaine HSE  
Expérience avec les logiciels de contrôle d’accès Sipass et Salto un atout  
Chargé de sécurité en protection incendie AEAI un atout  
Formation en premiers secours/samaritain un atout  
Maîtriser des outils MS office  
De langue maternelle française ou niveau minimum C1, toutes autres langues constituent un atout.  
Début de l’activité : de suite ou à convenir  
Type de contrat : CDI  
Lieu de travail : Vallorbe  
Si vous répondez à ces critères et que le défi lié au poste éveille votre intérêt, nous vous invitons à postuler en transmettons votre candidature complète (CV, certificats, lettre de motivation, diplômes...).  
Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature. jpid040083fjm jit0729jm jiy26jm

description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

Have we piqued your interest?

Then apply with your CV and a few clicks via our online form! No cover letter is necessary.

Do you have any questions? Then feel free to send us an email at malte.ruetten@softwareone.com.

title: Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS HGCAL
description:
What you'll do
As Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in the development, integration, testing and commissioning of the power systems for one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived.

Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the procurement and testing of power supplies for HGCAL detector modules, including low-voltage, high-current supplies for the readout electronics and medium-voltage supplies of up to 800 V for sensor biasing.

You will also contribute to the integration of power systems with the detector's safety, control and monitoring systems, as well as the testing and implementation of power components such as DC-DC converters, voltage regulation and cabling.

A key aspect of the role will be to assess the impact of the power system on HGCAL performance and to develop and implement strategies to minimise noise effects such as interference, coupling and ripple.

This role offers the opportunity to combine strong electrical engineering and detector-physics skills with hands-on involvement in the construction, testing and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Follow the procurement of the power supplies (Low Voltage and Bias Voltage, totalling several MCHF), including carrying out acceptance and stress tests on the delivered units.
Support the commissioning of these power systems during the mass assembly and testing phases of HGCAL.
Work with physicists and engineers to evaluate the performance of HGCAL in relation to its power systems and to develop and implement mitigation strategies where possible and necessary, first on the surface and subsequently when HGCAL is installed in CMS, 100 metres underground.
Work with the HGCAL and central CMS Technical Coordination teams to oversee the installation and testing of the power systems underground in the "Service" and "Experimental" caverns. This will include overseeing cable installation, in-situ connectorisation where needed, testing and commissioning, and the integration of the power system into the HGCAL and CMS safety and monitoring systems.

Your profile
Strong track record in testing, operating and debugging power systems for complex devices, such as particle detectors used in high-energy physics experiments.
Experience with silicon- and/or scintillator-based particle detectors would be an advantage.
Experience with large-scale procurement of electronic systems, such as power supplies.
Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Construction, test and installation of power electronic components and systems.
Specification and follow-up of technical aspects of a contract.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Assimilates large quantities of information, identifies key issues and formulates conclusions clearly and concisely.
Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

title: Commercial Excellence Lead (m/f/d)
description:
Within the Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA). Strong, trusted partnership with cluster commercial operations teams is essential to the success of this role. Key stakeholders will be the EEMEA Leadership Team (LT), HHI Commercial Operations, regional Chief Marketing Officers (CMO) & Regional Commercial Leads (RCL), and market Commercial Operations Directors (CODs.)
This is a Band 400 individual-contributor role. The primary location is Switzerland, with secondary locations in the Europe or Middle East time zones may be considered upon further discussion with the hiring manager. The role includes approximately 25% travel within Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa.
Responsibilities:
Commercial Capabilities:  Drive customer engagement evolution in partnership with Digital Engagement teams, ensuring commercial capabilities, segmentation, omnichannel execution and customer insights are translated into improved customer experience and business outcomes.
Relevant focus areas include:
•    Sales Force Effectiveness: Ensure proper Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), target setting, CRM operations and upgrades, and Sales Force of the Future (SFOF) deployment in select markets.  Ensure an ongoing focus on segmentation and targeting and Multichannel Cycle Plans (MCCP) efforts in the region.  Leverage data, analytics and business insights to improve sales force effectiveness in the region.
•    Key Account Management:  Ensure the roll out of Key Account Management and Top Customer programs in the region. Ensure successful capability roll-out and work with Market Access and Franchises to increase access at account level.
•    Commercial Trade Channels: Align with HHI on new capability roll-out and support markets in uncovering Commercial Trade Channel (CTC) opportunities.
Operational Governance & Execution:  Work with all relevant stakeholders to secure the EEMEA Commercial Operations & Strategy (CO&S) vision and business strategies and proactively identify and execute projects and programs of strategic importance to the region and our customers in a timely, effective, and efficient fashion. Be the communicator / connector / catalyst for cross-functional projects managed by extended regional stakeholders. Relevant focus areas include:
•    CO&S Governance: Manage all governance activities for the CO&S department, including setting the agenda for virtual and face-to-face meetings and periodic forum calls with market leads and other relevant stakeholders.
•    Business Impact Measurement: Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the impact of commercial capability investments, ensuring visibility to adoption, effectiveness, customer outcomes and business value realization.
•    Continuous Improvement: Continue to identify opportunities to drive simplification and harmonization across the region in collaboration with CO&S stakeholders including Digital Human Health (DHH). Support markets and the region in Objective & Key Result (OKR) transformation projects where requested.  Bring external industry best practices and innovative approaches into the region to continuously elevate commercial excellence.
•    Marketing Capabilities: Partner with regional Learning & Development (L&D), CMOs, and RCLs to build and scale marketing capabilities with a focus on L3 next deployment and sustainment.
•    Regional Projects: Ensure the successful deployment of projects associated with regional initiatives, priorities, and experimentations.
Launch Excellence:  Lead commercial-capability readiness that carries our emerging pipeline to flawless launch execution across markets. Relevant focus areas include:
•    Launch Capability Readiness: Partner with RCLs and market teams to ensure markets have the appropriate Go to Market (G2M) planning, segmentation, targeting, field-force sizing, training, forecasting support, and launch playbooks are in place well ahead of launch.
•    Launch Framework & Tracking: Establish a repeatable EEMEA launch-excellence framework and toolkit, with launch tracking that gives leadership visibility to timelines, milestones and risks.
AI-Enabled Commercial Excellence:  Champion the responsible adoption of GenAI across commercial workflows — helping teams work faster and smarter while safeguarding compliance and quality — and explore opportunities to embed AI into sales, marketing, field-force and launch ways of working, in partnership with key stakeholders.
Talent Development:  Build & support commercial-operations talent and capability development across the region.
We are looking for a commercially minded leader with 10+ years across sales, marketing, commercial operations and launch readiness who has successfully deployed commercial excellence capabilities in a complex, multinational environment. Combines strategic thinking with execution discipline, excels at influencing without authority, and has a strong track record of leading change, building capabilities, and translating data and technology into measurable business outcomes.

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Bergdoktor / Bergärztin (m/w/d) – Region Bern, Schweiz (Facharzt/-ärztin - Allgemeinmedizin (Hausarzt/-ärztin))
employer: Personal Spezial Personalservice & Vermittlung Hansjürgen Mathiak
description:
Wo Deine Expertise auf Lebensqualität trifft, berühren Deine Hände Menschen und Deine Seele Atmet Auf.
Spürst Du noch das tief verwurzelte Gefühl, warum Du einst den Weg der Medizin gewählt hast? War es die Sehnsucht, echten Unterschied zu bewirken, nah am Menschen zu sein und Heilung dort zu bringen, wo Vertrauen das Fundament jedes Gesprächs bildet?
In der malerischen Kulisse der Berner Bergwelt wartet eine Praxis auf Dich, die genau diesen Herzschlag der ursprünglichen Medizin lebt. Hier verblassen der lähmende Druck anonymer Großkliniken und die endlose Bürokratie. Stattdessen öffnest Du morgens das Fenster, atmest die klare, frische Bergluft tief ein und schaust auf ein erhabenes Panorama, das Dir schon vor dem ersten Patienten Ruhe und Klarheit schenkt.
Was Dich bei uns erwartet
Ganzheitliche, menschliche Medizin: Du hast die Zeit, wirklich hinzuhören, den Menschen hinter den Symptomen zu sehen und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen über Jahre aufzubauen.
Das Beste aus zwei Welten: Eine modern ausgestattete Praxis mitten in einer majestätischen Naturkulisse, die Raum für fundierte Diagnostik und familiäre Entfaltung bietet.
Freiraum und Lebensqualität: Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und verlässliche Freizeit, damit Du die Natur vor Deiner Haustür nicht nur durchs Fenster siehst, sondern aktiv genießen kannst.
Wertschätzendes Umfeld: Ein eingespieltes, herzliches Praxisteam, das Dir den Rücken freihält und Dir das Gefühl gibt, genau am richtigen Ort angekommen zu sein.
Attraktive Schweizer Rahmenbedingungen: Exzellente Honorierung, hohe Lebensqualität und umfassende Unterstützung bei allen organisatorischen Schritten des Ankommens.
Dein Profil
Du besitzt ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Humanmedizin sowie einen Facharzttitel für Allgemeine Innere Medizin oder Allgemeinmedizin (oder stehst kurz davor).
Du trägst die Leidenschaft für die Hausarztmedizin im Herzen und schätzt die Eigenverantwortung ebenso wie den menschlichen Kontakt.
Du bringst Einfühlungsvermögen, Nahbarkeit und die innere Ruhe mit, die den Menschen in einer ländlichen Region Sicherheit vermittelt.
Du freust Dich darauf, in einer der schönsten Regionen der Schweiz Wurzeln zu schlagen.
Spürst Du, dass es Zeit für eine Veränderung ist?
Schließe für einen kurzen Moment die Augen und stelle Dir vor, wie es sich anfühlt, mit Freude und Gelassenheit zur Arbeit zu gehen – getragen von Respekt, Natur und echter Erfüllung.
Wenn sich dieser Gedanke für Dich richtig und stimmig anfühlt, freuen wir uns auf ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch.

Stellenbeschreibung:
Unsere Mandantin ist die MeikoVet Gruppe, die einzige inhabergeführte, tierärztliche Praxisgruppe in der Schweiz. Sie verfügt zurzeit über 13 Standorte in der Deutschschweiz und verbindet die Vorteile der zentralen Verwaltung mit hoher Autonomie der lokalen Standorte. Die MeikoVet Gruppe fördert sowohl den Austausch zwischen ihren Tierärztinnen untereinander als auch die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Spezialisten. Die Unterstützung bei der persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterbildung ist bei MeikoVet selbstverständlich. Somit praktizieren MeikoVet Tierärztinnen die Veterinärmedizin auf hohem Niveau zum Wohle der Tiere und ihrer Kunden.

Die weitläufige, erst 2023 in einem Neubau eröffnete Kleintierpraxis in St. Gallen hat den Charakater einer Haustierarztpraxis und verfügt neben den modernen Konsultationszimmern auch über einen gut ausgebauten OP-Bereich. Die Praxis ist nicht nur für Vorsorgeuntersuchungen und Impfungen sondern auch für Operationen wie Kastrationen, Weichteiloperationen, Wundversorgung, Zahnbehandlungen und Operationen am äußeren Auge bestens ausgestattet. Dadurch kann die MeikoVet Praxis St. Gallen auf Basis eines bestehenden Kundenstamms ihr breites Leistungsangebot in zeitgemäßer Umgebung anbieten.

Im Zuge einer Nachfolgeregelung suchen wir im Auftrag unserer Mandantin zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Teilzeit (mind. 60 %) oder Vollzeit die

Leitende Tierärztin St. Gallen, Schweiz (m/w/d)

Die Aufgabe:

- Sie bilden gemeinsam mit der leitenden tiermedizinischen Praxisassistentin (TPA) das Führungsteam der Praxis, in der Tierärztinnen, TPAs, Lernende und ein Belegtierarzt für Kleintierchirurgie tätig sind.
- Sie sind für Patientenbesitzerinnen sowie das Kollegium erste Ansprechpartnerin für tiermedizinische Fragestellungen.
- Sie führen regelmäßig die allgemeine Sprechstunde durch.
- Junge tierärztliche Kolleginnen und Kollegen werden durch Sie kollegial ausgebildet und angeleitet.
- Sie führen Routineeingriffe wie Kastrationen, Weichteilchirurgie, Wundversorgung und Zahnbehandlungen eigenständig durch.
- Zusammen mit der leitenden TPA sind Sie für die betriebswirtschaftliche Entwicklung der Praxis verantwortlich.
- Sie führen zusammen mit der leitenden TPA Kundenevents, z. B. Nothelferkurse oder Informationanlässe durch.
- Sie berichten direkt an die COO der MeikoVet Gruppe.

Die Anforderungen:

- Eidgenössisches oder EU-Diplom in Veterinärmedizin.
- Kantonale Berufsausübungsbewilligung bzw. Erfüllung der Voraussetzungen zur Erteilung der Berufsausübungsbewilligung (u. a. Deutschkenntnisse).
- Freude am Kontakt mit Kunden und den vierbeinigen Patienten.
- Einige Jahre praktische Erfahrung sowie Eigeninitiative und Qualitätsorientierung.
- Begeisterung für eine überschaubare, leitenden Position. Führungserfahrung ist kein Muss, aber der Wunsch in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen.
- Sie sind ein echter Teamplayer und übernehmen gerne Verantwortung.
- Klare und empathische Kommunikation sowohl innerhalb des Teams als auch mit Patientenbesitzerinnen und Patientenbesitzern ist für Sie selbstverständlich.
- Bereitschaft zu Hausbesuchen.
- Interesse an betriebswirtschaftlichen Themen.
- Routine im Umgang mit MS-Office und einer Praxismanagement-Software.

Das Angebot:

Hier können Sie als „Junior-Führungskraft“ Leitung auf einer soliden Basis lernen. MeikoVet ist ein solides Schweizer Unternehmen mit bewußt moderatem Wachtumskurs. Die Entwicklung der bereits bestehenden Standorte hat mehr Gewicht, als der Zukauf weiterer Praxen. Vor diesem Hintergrund bieten wir Ihnen die nicht alltägliche Gelegenheit „Ihre“ Praxis nach eigenen Vorstellungen zu entwickeln und vom gesamten MeikoVet Netzwerk zu profitieren. In der Leitungsrolle bei MeikoVet genießen Sie viele Freiheiten und Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten bei gleichzeitiger Unterstützung durch die Gruppe und den Austausch mit den anderen Standortleitungen. Sie teilen die Verantwortung mit einer Kollegin und sind in kritischen Situationen vor Ort nie allein. Das MeikoVet Team bietet Ihnen die nötigen Rahmenbedingungen, um Ihre persönlichen Potentiale zu entfalten. Es erwartet Sie Unterstützung bei internen und externen Fortbildungen. Eine gesunde, familiäre und von Wertschätzung geprägte Arbeitsatmosphäre sowie regelmässige Team-Meetings und -Events liegen MeikoVet besonders am Herzen.

title: rdinator for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
description:
What you'll do
As Field Coordinator for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in coordinating and overseeing the assembly, integration, testing and commissioning of one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived. Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will help coordinate the mass assembly and testing of HGCAL detector elements ("cassettes") on the surface, their integration into the complete 250-tonne detector, and the subsequent system-level testing.

You will also contribute to the installation and commissioning of HGCAL approximately 100 metres underground within CMS, including the integration and testing of essential services such as CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and optical fibres. This role offers the opportunity to combine strong technical coordination skills with hands-on involvement in the construction and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Oversee the operation and maintenance of the HGCAL assembly and testing facilities at CERN, which include large ISO 7 cleanrooms and a large assembly hall. These areas are equipped with high-power electrical and cooling infrastructure that must be operated continuously and safely. You will be responsible for planning and organising the execution of all interventions in these facilities.
Provide technical support to physicists, engineers and technicians using these facilities. This will include liaising with the HGCAL Technical Coordinators and Safety Officer, as well as with the central CMS Technical Coordination team and CERN service groups (e.g. HVAC, electrical infrastructure, etc.).
Plan and supervise all activities related to the large-scale detector integration, including cassette insertion (Hadronic section of HGCAL - CE-H) and stacking (Electromagnetic section - CE-E), the mechanical and electrical connection between CE-E and CE-H, installation and testing of the HGCAL thermal screen (to maintain the exterior at a warm temperature while the interior is cold), and cold testing of the complete detector.
Work with the HGCAL team to plan and execute tests of "sectors" of HGCAL on the surface, and similarly when HGCAL is installed inside CMS.
Work with the HGCAL Engineering Team to ensure the safe transport of large and delicate HGCAL structures around the site, as well as the overall lowering of HGCAL into the experimental cavern.
Oversee logistics for HGCAL-related items, including detector modules, cassettes, ancillary equipment and mechanical components.

Your profile
Strong track record in planning and coordinating facilities for the assembly and testing of complex devices, such as particle detectors.
Demonstrated experience in the assembly and testing of particle detectors, particularly those based on silicon sensors, would be an advantage.
Familiarity with project planning tools such as Merlin and MS Project.
Proven ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multidisciplinary teams of engineers, scientists and technicians.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Operation and maintenance of electromechanical equipment and systems.
Operation and support of experimental facilities.
Organisation, planning and control.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
Coordinates activities and focuses team on goals and objectives; monitors progress of team towards agreed goals and takes corrective action when needed.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Anticipates obstacles; assesses alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.
Objectively assesses and monitors own work; regularly reports on progress and advises of any changes in schedule or priorities.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

title: Mechanical Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
description:
What you'll do:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the development, procurement, assembly, testing and installation of innovative mechanical structures for the High Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL) of the Compact Muon Solenoid experiment, working with advanced materials and challenging structural and thermal requirements.

You will help oversee the surface assembly and testing of the 250-tonne detector, including its CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and fibre services, as well as its installation and commissioning 100 metres underground. Working in a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will apply your expertise in structural and thermal calculations, finite element analysis and 3D CAD.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinate a team of technicians in assembling and testing the steel structures of HGCAL, comprising more than 200 tonnes of steel plates per endcap.
- Provide engineering support for all activities at CERN related to the large-scale active detector components, known as "cassettes" (30-60-degree segments of circular structures with diameters of up to 5 m). This will include the cold testing of "electromagnetic cassettes" and their subsequent stacking with lead plates to form the complete electromagnetic endcaps.
- Integrate the hadronic cassettes into the steel structures and provide support for their testing.
- Integrate the electromagnetic (30 tonnes) and hadronic (200 tonnes) sections, including their cabling and piping, and support subsequent large-scale testing on the surface.
- Help oversee the lowering of the HGCAL endcaps into the CMS cavern and their connection to CMS, including the connection and testing of services.

Your profile:
- Strong track record in planning and coordinating the handling, assembling and testing of large mechanical structures.
- Demonstrated experience in performing thermal and structural calculations of complex mechanical structures using finite element analysis.
- Demonstrated experience in developing mechanical assemblies using 3D CAD.
- Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
- Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment: Knowledge of usual manufacturing methods (milling, turning, etc.), assembly methods (bolted, welding, etc.).
- Knowledge and application of mechanical measurement techniques: including quality control methods.
- Assembly and integration of detectors: capability to develop and validate manufacturing and installation methods.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models: proficiency in Catia V5 or equivalent 3D modelling software, good knowledge of drawing annotations.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling applied to mechanics.
- Proficiency in ANSYS would be a strong asset.
- Basic understanding of process engineering systems (i.e. cooling plants) would be an asset.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Adopts a pragmatic approach; understands the value of adopting generic rather than gold -plated' technical solutions.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Delivers presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusts style and content to the audience; responds calmly and confidently to questions.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 48
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 200090 - Mechanical Engineer
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
description:
